title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Hilo by Aktiia**

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

### **Role overview**

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

### **Core responsibilities**

### **Direction & Outcomes**

* Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
* Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

### **Design System & Prototyping**

* Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
* Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
* Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
* Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

 **Requirements**

### **Background & Experience**

### **Essential**

* Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
* 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
* Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
* High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
* Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
* Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
* Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
* A public portfolio website (required with your application).

### **Nice to Have**

* Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

### **How you work**

* AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
* Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
* Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
* Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
* Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
* Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

### **This isn't for you if**

* You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
* You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
* You'd rather list risks than own one.

### **How we hire**

* Recruiter screen (30 min)
* Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
* Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
* Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
* Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

### **What success looks like**

* You take something off our plate and it gets done.
* If it won't happen, you tell us first.
* You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
* You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
* The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

  
**Benefits**

### **What Makes You A Great Fit**

**At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:**

**Move the Needle** — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

**Move Fast, Learn, Refine** — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

**Team First** — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
* Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
* Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
* Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
* Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

### **Ready to Move the Needle?**

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Lead Yaw Systems Mechanical Engineer
description:

The mechanical design engineer will primarily support the hydraulic + passive mechanical braking systems through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

You will:

* Execute projects pertaining to new product introduction, new technology integration, and field issue resolution with a heavy focus on quality and reliability verified by physical testing
* Be responsible for designing yaw system components for wind turbines focusing on hydraulic pressure unit (HPU) systems, yaw bearings, yaw drives, and yaw brakes encompassing component design, system interaction, and system reliability
* Hold ownership of and drive lessons learned, best practices, and standardization into design related documentation such as design practices, drawings, and technical specifications
* Responsible for design, development of testing/validation plans to prove component function and reliability
* Provide innovative design solutions to meet aggressive timing, product cost, and reliability targets
* Ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs, and specifications applying all GEV and industry processes, standards, and best practices
* Work cross functionally, developing strong relationships with quality teams, manufacturing engineers, sourcing, suppliers, field support, and others to improve product quality and first-time yield
* Support manufacturing, sourcing, and the field with issue resolution and quick corrective actions for design related causes (NCR, SDR, PAC)
* Drive quick, complete technical root cause analysis of field failures and identify design related corrective actions to prevent recurrence
* Identify and execute cost saving ideas and strategies
Drive efforts to introduce advanced technology, materials, manufacturing methods, new design tools/methods to advance the strategic position of yaw subsystem components  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Significant experience in mechanical analysis and design experience in industry
* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing
* Experience with 3D-CAD tools like Unigraphics / Siemens NX

* Excellent communication, project management, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across cultural boundaries
* Ability to work under pressure and challenging conditions
* Established problem solving process knowledge and execution
* Strong desire and ability to drive improvement and change
* Fluent English written and spoken
* Ability to travel up to 10%
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Working knowledge of Ansys or other finite element analysis tools
* Design experience working on components in the wind turbine yaw subsystem (yaw drives, yaw bearings, bolted joints, hydraulic + mechanical yaw braking systems)
* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA, and design for manufacturability / installation / serviceability.

* Proven track record of collaborating with business product managers and suppliers/vendors to optimize component costs and influence purchasing strategy

title: Director, Site Enablement Solutions
description:
Barcelona, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1578075

  

**Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships.**
-------------------------------------------------------

  
  

IQVIA is changing an entire industry through inspired innovation. Our people make the difference. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we look for talented people and give them meaningful work to do. Join IQVIA and help us drive healthcare forward.

**Job Overview**
----------------

  
  

IQVIA Site Enablement Solutions provides site-based clinical research support designed to help sponsors and research sites address capacity, enrolment, and study execution challenges. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Head of Site Enablement Solutions, the Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships will lead execution of the business growth strategy through strategic account planning, executive customer engagement, customer expansion, opportunity conversion, and commercialization of emerging capabilities.

  
  

This is an execution-focused commercial leadership role requiring deep expertise in site support, site augmentation, and site engagement. The Director will develop customer-specific solutions and creative commercial structures that balance customer needs with pricing, geographic reach, implementation requirements, and operational delivery feasibility. The role will be dedicated to Site Enablement Solutions and will work across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy to convert opportunities into sustainable, deliverable partnerships.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

  
  

* Lead strategic account planning and growth execution across priority customer relationships.
* Develop account-specific expansion plans across therapeutic areas, geographies, studies, and delivery models to increase adoption and support repeatable, multi-study growth.
* Convert study-level and country-level engagements into broader portfolio and enterprise relationships.
* Build and maintain executive customer relationships, stakeholder maps, sponsorship models, and governance approaches.
* Identify and advance competitive opportunities where IQVIA can differentiate through global reach, flexibility, integrated capabilities, and measurable customer outcomes.
* Lead the design of customized site support solutions and commercial structures that align customer requirements with operational feasibility and sustainable delivery.
* Partner with Business Development and account teams throughout opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal strategy, pricing, negotiation, and bid defense.
* Increase inclusion and penetration of site support solutions within Full Service opportunities, particularly programs where site capacity or enrolment risk is material.
* Create repeatable frameworks for account growth, opportunity follow-up, pipeline-to-revenue tracking, objection handling, and conversion discipline.
* Support competitive pricing approaches, quantified value assumptions, and commercially viable alternatives in collaboration with Finance, Strategy, and Delivery.
* Translate emerging capabilities into clear, customer-ready propositions, use cases, and integrated solution pathways.
* Strengthen value articulation through return-on-investment models, key performance indicator frameworks, case studies, proof points, and differentiated customer storytelling.
* Partner with Delivery and regional teams to incorporate country readiness, resource models, contracting, pricing, and implementation requirements into commercial planning.
* Capture customer and market feedback and translate insights into offering, process, technology, and geographic expansion priorities.
* Serve as a member of the Site Enablement Solutions leadership team and provide visible ownership of the growth agenda.
* Partner with customer-facing and operational leaders to strengthen account management maturity and commercial effectiveness.
* Establish disciplined account reviews, opportunity ownership, executive stakeholder mapping, and progress reporting against growth priorities.
* Provide coaching and subject matter guidance to colleagues supporting customer engagement and solution positioning.
* Initially operate as an individual contributor; the role may assume leadership of customer-aligned delivery resources as the operating model and business needs evolve.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

  
  

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research, healthcare services, contract research organization services, site services, or a related life sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic account management, customer partnerships, commercial growth, solution development, or business development.
* Demonstrated experience in site support, site augmentation, site engagement, enrolment acceleration, or related patient and site services.
* Experience designing and negotiating complex, customized service solutions that require alignment across commercial and operational stakeholders.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research organizations.
* Experience working within global and highly matrixed organizations.

**Additional Skills:**
----------------------

  
  

* Deep understanding of clinical trial operations, research-site workflows, site capacity constraints, and sponsor decision-making.
* Strong commercial judgment and ability to balance customer value, competitive positioning, pricing, operational feasibility, and financial sustainability.
* Ability to convert strategic priorities into executable account plans and measurable actions.
* Executive-level communication, influencing, relationship management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead through influence across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures, regions, and time zones, with strong command of English.
* Knowledge of global delivery models, resource sourcing, site contracting, and country activation considerations is preferred.
* Experience coaching or leading customer-facing teams is preferred.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

At IQVIA, we believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging empower our mission to accelerate innovation for a healthier world. We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. When our talented employees bring their authentic selves and their diverse experiences to work, they enable us to accomplish extraordinary things. Multifaceted thought processes spark innovation. Multi-talented collaboration harnesses innovation to deliver superior outcomes. Likewise, as part of this culture, IQVIA is committed to ensuring effective equality between women and men, integrating it as a strategic principle in its corporate and human resources policies.

**Where you'll work**
---------------------

### **Home-based**

You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.

  

**Culture**
-----------

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Director of Brand & Creative
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

*Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our* *contentsquare.com* *or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.*

We are looking for a senior creative leader to **define the next chapter of Contentsquare’s brand and lead the evolution of our global Studio.**

You will set the creative vision for how Contentsquare shows up in the world. Your mission is to elevate our brand, making it more distinctive, modern, and recognizable, and ensuring our creative expression positions us as a leader in our industry.

You will drive the **creative evolution of our brand across every touchpoint**, from campaigns and product launches to web, events, motion, and executive storytelling. You'll push creative boundaries, champion bold ideas, and set an exceptional standard for quality and differentiation.

A key part of the role is translating complex technology, data, and AI innovation into simple, compelling creative experiences. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, and GTM teams to understand what makes our platform unique and bring that story to life.

You'll also **lead and transform our global Studio**, developing a high-performing team of designers, creative leads, and agency partners. You'll evolve our brand system and embrace AI, automation, and self-service to scale production, freeing the team to focus on creativity, craft, and high-impact work.

**Your mission: build a category-defining brand and a world-class, AI-enabled creative organization to bring it to life.**

### **What you’ll own**

### **Brand creative direction**

* Set the creative vision for Contentsquare and hold an exceptional standard across launches, campaigns, brand, web, events, and executive storytelling.
* Champion bold ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and push the team beyond safe, predictable creative work.
* Stay ahead of what the best brands are doing, in SaaS, AI, technology, and beyond, to create work that is unmistakably ours.

### **The team**

* Lead, develop, and retain exceptional designers and team leads, building a high-performing culture of craft, bold thinking, ownership, and accountability. Empower the team to take creative risks and make strong decisions independently.
* Build and manage a network of world-class agencies and specialist partners, bringing fresh perspectives and expertise. Own agency selection, creative direction, budgets, and performance, ensuring exceptional quality and the flexibility to scale during peak demand.

### **The platform and product story**

* Build a deep understanding of our platform, AI capabilities, and technology, keeping the Studio closely connected to our product and customers.
* Partner early with Product and Product Marketing to turn complex technology into simple, compelling, and memorable creative experiences.
* Bring our product story to life through distinctive design, motion, video, and storytelling across every relevant touchpoint.

### **The Brand System**

* Evolve our visual identity into a distinctive, recognizable, and scalable brand system that reflects our ambition as an AI leader.
* Build reusable frameworks, templates, and self-service tools that help teams create effectively without compromising quality.
* Know when to scale through the system and when an idea deserves something entirely new.

### **AI in the studio**

* Lead how the Studio uses AI across design, copy, production, and creative operations.
* Use AI to absorb repetitive work and production volume, expanding creative capabilities and giving the team more time for ideas, craft, and innovation.
* Help the team adopt new tools and workflows confidently, without compromising creative quality or brand standards.

### **How the creative studio runs**

* Own the Studio operating model, including priorities, resourcing, project management, creative reviews, and delivery across internal teams and external partners.
* Build a fast, effective, and scalable operation that anticipates demand, manages production peaks, and removes unnecessary complexity.
* Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, Content, Web, Comms, and GTM teams, engaging early enough to shape the work rather than simply receive briefs.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years across design, brand, creative, or Studio leadership, including 5+ years leading teams in SaaS or technology.
* Experience managing managers/team leads and operating in complex, global organizations.
* Exceptional portfolio with a high creative bar across brand, digital, campaigns, and product storytelling.
* Strong ability to turn complex technology and AI into simple, compelling creative narratives.
* Deep understanding of SaaS/tech; AI or AI-native experience is a strong plus.
* Proven experience evolving brand/design systems and scaling quality through templates and self-service.
* Hands-on experience transforming creative teams with AI across workflows, automation, production, and enablement.
* Strong command of Creative Operations, resourcing, agencies, and end-to-end Studio workflows.
* Strong benchmarking instincts and a clear point of view on differentiation and creative excellence.
* Excellent executive communication and cross-functional partnership skills.

### **You’ll Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have **exceptional creative taste and a strong point of view** on what our brand could become.
* Understand the product deeply enough to find the creative idea within it, rather than waiting for a brief to define it.
* Turn complex technology, data, and AI into simple, human, and memorable creative experiences.
* Know what the best brands are doing, both in our category and far beyond it, and are more interested in **what nobody has done yet**.
* Move confidently between setting creative vision, challenging the details, shaping product storytelling, and leading a high-performing team.
* See **AI as a way to take more creative risks, not fewer**. Let it handle the volume so your team can focus on the work only people can do.
* Build simple systems that keep creative teams fast, collaborative, and effective, while knowing which work deserves something entirely original.
* Challenge work that's merely good enough, inspiring teams and agency partners to push for exceptional.
* Balance bold creative ambition with a strong understanding of customer impact and business outcomes.

### **What Success Looks Like**

Within your first year, we would expect to see:

* A visibly higher and more consistent creative bar across the company.
* A distinctive creative language for our platform, products, and AI capabilities that makes complex technology easier to understand and more exciting to experience.
* A Studio that is deeply connected to Product and Product Marketing and engaged earlier in the storytelling process.
* Strong differentiation from competitors across our visual identity, campaigns, product launches, and customer-facing experiences.
* A strong, scalable brand and design system.
* A clear Studio operating model with stronger prioritization, ownership, and delivery.
* Meaningful adoption of AI across creative workflows, resulting in faster execution, better output, and expanded team capacity.
* More teams able to self-serve effectively through high-quality templates, systems, and guidelines.
* Strong leadership across the Studio, with team leads operating with greater autonomy and accountability.
* Better balance between internal resources, agencies, automation, and self-service.
* A Studio viewed by the business not as a production function, but as a strategic partner in how we bring our product and technology to the world.

**Why you should join Contentsquare**

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

* Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year

* Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies

* Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

* Lifestyle allowance

* A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work

* Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

* We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

* And more benefits tailored to each country

*Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our* *Job Candidate Privacy Notice* *to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal* *here**.*

*Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.*

*Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Policy**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Marketing Technology Engineer (BCN)
description:

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. **Working in MarTech with WPP Enterprise Solutions**

WPP Enterprise Solutions is a full-service digital agency helping ambitious brands deliver connected, personalised experiences across digital channels. Our expertise spans Marketing, Commerce, CRM, PXM and CX, enabling us to deliver end-to-end solutions with measurable impact.

Our clients include Bayer, MSD, Dyson, Johnson & Johnson, RTL, Nestlé, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein and other global brands. Our teams are based in Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Poland and India, with access to the wider WPP network worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

You'll help design and build MarTech solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and the wider Salesforce platform, working collaboratively across the wider team. Depending on the client, you may work across platforms such as Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach and Adobe, together with data and cloud technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Tealium, Segment, AWS, Azure and GCP.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Design the solution and data**

* You help shape the data model and integrations, then build, test and support reliable production code with the wider team.
* Most of our depth sits in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, but the architecture rarely stops at one platform.
* Relational schemas, keys, retention, extract and ingestion strategies.
* Identity resolution across fragmented sources.

**2. Build the integrations**

* REST, SOAP, webhooks, batch or event-driven - you help select the right pattern, implement it and ensure failures recover safely.
* Work at the warehouse and CDP layer, not just the activation platform at the end of it.

**3. Build maintainable solutions**

* Build with AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid, Jinja or general-purpose code, depending on the platform and problem.
* Queries and automation logic driving segmentation and journeys at volume.
* Improve the team's versioning, review and deployment practices where they add value.
* Decisions documented so they outlast your engagement.

**4. Translate for the client**

* Shape ambiguous requirements into something buildable and present the solution yourself.

**What You Bring**

**1. Software Engineering**

* Production experience with Node.js, Python, Java, PHP or .NET.
* You write maintainable, tested and idempotent code with effective error handling and logging.

**2. Data Engineering and Architecture**

* Strong SQL against large datasets - not just reads, but the queries that drive segmentation and automation.
* You understand customer identity resolution across fragmented sources, including deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship and profile consolidation.

**3. Integration and Delivery**

* Delivered a production integration using REST, SOAP or webhooks.
* Understands batch and event-driven patterns, rate limits, retries, failure recovery and duplicate prevention.
* Hands-on version control in a team setting - branching, pull requests, peer review.

**4. Front-end Development**

* Comfortable building and debugging rendered output with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

**5. Marketing Platform Delivery**

* Hands-on delivery on an enterprise marketing or CRM platform - Salesforce, Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe or equivalent.
* Built audience segmentation and multi-step customer journeys against a live data source.
* Worked directly with marketing stakeholders on requirements, not only via a ticket queue.

**Bonus experience**

* Additional Marketing Automation Experience: Salesforce Personalization, Pardot or Marketing Cloud Next; Adobe Campaign, Journey Optimizer or Marketo Engage; or HubSpot.
* Core CRM Platforms: Salesforce Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce or Industry Clouds.
* CDP Platforms: Data Cloud, Tealium, Segment or equivalent.
* Platform Development: AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid, Jinja.
* Data Engineering and Architecture: ETL / ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data governance, big data.
* APIs & Integration: GraphQL.
* Front-end Development: React, Angular, Vue.
* DevOps: CI/CD, SFMC DevTools, Salesforce CLI, Copado, Gearset.
* Email Development: Responsive email build, including cross-client and dark mode testing.
* Email Deliverability: Sending reputation and authentication - SPF, DKIM, DMARC, dedicated IP warming.

**How You Work**

**1.Stay hands-on across the delivery lifecycle**

* This is a hands-on developer role. You help design and build solutions using platform languages, SQL and the appropriate integration technologies.
* You also review, audit, migrate and improve inherited solutions.
* You build solutions that are bulk-safe, observable and tested, with error handling and logging included from the start.
* You name things properly, you leave comments where the platform forced an ugly decision, and you don't hand over a black box.

**2. Platform-pragmatic**

* You work the constraint rather than resenting it. Enterprise marketing platforms often won't let you build the elegant solution, and you find the one that holds.
* You know when a platform's native tooling is enough and when the problem belongs in real code.

**3. Design, document and deliver responsibly**

* You consider the data model and integration pattern before building, keeping the design effort proportionate to the problem.
* You write the design down. Decisions and trade-offs outlast your engagement.
* You take responsibility for what you ship and can diagnose production issues.
* Your work lives in version control, gets reviewed by peers, and deploys the same way twice.
* You'd rather have a design challenged early than find the problem in production.

**4. Client-facing across disciplines**

* You lead requirements discussions and present solutions clearly to both marketing and technical stakeholders.
* You adapt the level of detail to your audience.
* You work closely with campaign operations, data engineers, developers and strategists, translating effectively between disciplines.

**In return, this is what we offer**

We encourage ambitious ideas, invest in your development and support a flexible, welcoming workplace.

**Our compensation**

* An annual gross salary of €43,700–€50,000, depending on experience.
* Company private health insurance.
* A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.

**Career progression**

* Deepen your technical path towards Senior Marketing Technology Engineer, with a longer-term route into Technical Lead responsibilities across a portfolio.
* Broaden your practice path by improving how we deliver, what we standardise and how the wider team develops.
* We'll help you build either path through demonstrated impact, growing responsibility and business need.

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Senior Planner / Strategist will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction for four leading pet care brands.

Embedded within our dedicated on-site agency hub in Barcelona, you will collaborate closely with the client's Global Brand Teams on high-impact global briefs. Your focus will be upstream and conceptual: uncovering transformative consumer and cultural insights, authoring inspirational creative briefs, defining brand and communication strategies, and building comprehensive global master toolkits.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an ambitious, culturally attuned, and insight-driven strategist to establish foundational strategic frameworks, elevate creative ambition, and influence the global trajectory of major pet care brands.

* Partner directly with the client's Global Marketing Leads and Brand Managers to define overarching brand, communication, and campaign strategies across cat and dog portfolios.
* Architect robust Global Master Toolkits, guidelines, and campaign architectures designed for global consistency and seamless future adaptation across regional markets.
* Interrogate client challenges to uncover the real commercial and cultural problems strategy needs to solve, converting complex business goals into clear, actionable creative propositions.

**Audience Insight & Cultural Intelligence**

* **Sector background:** Proven experience working on FMCG, CPG, Pet Care, or consumer lifestyle brands. Experience navigating multi-brand portfolios is a significant plus.
* **Global & conceptual scope:** A demonstrated track record delivering global briefs, brand platforms, and master campaign toolkits (brand and communication planning, not solely channel execution).

title: Head of Content
description:
**About us**
============

At THEKER, we're taking on one of the greatest challenges of the 21st century: redefining how physical work gets done in the world.

We are a robotics and AI company building intelligent, adaptable systems that solve problems traditional automation never could. From Barcelona, our mission is to create a generation-defining company leading the robotics revolution.

By joining us, you will have the chance to do the most meaningful work of your life, setting a new standard for industrial automation and driving breakthroughs with global reach, while being surrounded by a focused, talent-dense team that shares this ambition and is here to win.

We recently closed the largest robotics Series A in Europe's history, and we're looking for the top 0.01% of talent to take on that mission with us, and build the biggest company in the world.

**Your role**
=============

We are looking for a Head of Content to run THEKER's content operation from request to delivery. You will receive what the company needs from marketing, decide what comes first and make sure it ships on time and on brand. This is an operations and management role with a strong eye for brand. You won't be designing or editing yourself, but you will know good work when you see it.

You will be the single point of contact for marketing requests across THEKER, from videos and photos to presentations and events. You will turn each request into a clear brief, assign it to the right person in the content team and follow it through to delivery. You will also own the materials our sales team uses with clients and keep them current and consistent.

Day to day, you will manage the team's timeline and keep several projects moving at once. You will work with the founders and with every team from engineering to sales. You will also track what each channel delivers and propose new actions, from trade fairs to formats we haven't tried yet. Success means every request has an owner and a date, and sales trusts every material it sends.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We are looking for a hybrid profile: part creative director, part motion designer, part AI-native creator and part team leader.

You should have:

* Strong experience in marketing or content, ideally B2B, including leading a creative team and giving clear, demanding creative direction.
* Strategic judgement. You set objectives, prioritize, and can explain why an action is worth doing.
* Strong brand and visual judgement, with deep knowledge of video and motion production. Your portfolio shows a point of view of its own.
* Solid copywriting in Spanish and English, plus comfort working with marketing metrics and analytics tools.
* A genuinely AI-native way of working. Claude should feel like your working environment, not an occasional tool.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate (100% on-site role).

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Knowledge of motion graphics or 3D.
* An AI-native way of working, with tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.
* Experience planning trade fairs and external events in industrial or tech sectors.
* A track record of turning complex technical products into content that non-technical audiences understand.

**You'll thrive at THEKER if**
------------------------------

* You're excited by a fast-paced and ambitious environment. The opportunity ahead of us is enormous, and we're going all in to capture it.
* You want responsibility early on, delivering at world-class standards for leading clients.
* You enjoy experimenting, iterating quickly, and embracing change as part of the learning process.
* You enjoy bringing order to many moving parts, and you're comfortable saying "not yet" when priorities require it.

**Main responsibilities**
=========================

* Own the single entry point for marketing requests from the rest of the company. Turn each one into a brief, prioritize it, assign it and track it to delivery.
* Manage the content team's calendar and coordinate internal and external collaborators on each project.
* Own every material that goes to GTM, from sales decks to product documentation, with clear versions and approvals.
* Act as the main contact for sales on what they need and what is out of date.
* Keep the message and the brand consistent in everything that reaches a client.
* Write and review copy for LinkedIn, presentations and product materials.
* Define the metrics for each channel and turn what they show into decisions.
* Choose and plan the trade fairs and external events we attend, and propose new channels and formats with a clear goal and a way to measure them.

**What we offer**
=================

* Being part of a fast-growing robotics and AI company with genuine ambition, where your career can accelerate alongside us.
* The chance to build THEKER's content function and decide how a robotics company should look and sound.
* A focused, talent-dense team where your work is visible and your decisions count.
* An environment where new ideas are encouraged and your contributions shape both the product and the company.
* 100% on-site work in Barcelona.

**What the process looks like**
===============================

* Intro call with Talent Team. 30 minutes.
* Portfolio review and a case study on a real THEKER content and marketing challenge.
* Conversation with the founding team.
* Meet the rest of the team and founders at our offices.

These steps can be completed in 7 days.

**Final observation**
=====================

We're committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome all applications regardless of background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, or beliefs.

title: Monitor/a dinamitzador/a espai migdia Horta (Barcelona)
description:
Tens experiència liderant equips de monitors/es i t’apassiona el lleure educatiu? Busquem una persona creativa, dinàmica i amb iniciativa que vulgui **motivar l’equip, impulsar activitats i potenciar la vessant educativa del servei de migdia**.

La teva missió serà acompanyar els monitors i monitores en el dia a dia i afavorir que s’impliquin activament en el projecte.

**Què faràs?**

* Dinamitzar i motivar l’equip de monitors/es, fomentant la participació, la iniciativa i el treball conjunt.
* Acompanyar l’equip en la gestió dels grups i dels diferents espais, compartint recursos i criteris educatius.
* Reforçar el rol educatiu del monitoratge, promovent un tracte proper amb els infants i mantenint els límits propis del rol professional.
* Preparar materials, jocs i activitats adaptats a les diferents edats, amb propostes cooperatives, creatives, esportives i de convivència.
* Preparar i dinamitzar petites reunions per compartir activitats, presentar propostes i afavorir la cohesió de l’equip.
* Detectar necessitats i proposar millores en el funcionament del servei.
* Treballar conjuntament amb la direcció de l’Espai Migdia i la persona de suport a la direcció, seguint les línies pedagògiques de la Fundació Pere Tarrés.

* **Centre de treball:** Horta, Barcelona.
* **Jornada:** 10 hores setmanals.
* **Horari:** de dilluns a dijous, de 12.30 a 15.00 h.
* **Retribució:** conveni de lleure
* **Contracte:** fix discontinu, vinculat al curs escolar.

* Titulació de monitor/a de lleure o formació relacionada amb l’àmbit socioeducatiu.
* Experiència en coordinació, dinamització o lideratge d’equips de monitors/es.
* Experiència en lleure educatiu i dinamització de grups d’infants.
* Capacitat de lideratge, comunicació i motivació d’equips.
* Creativitat, iniciativa i capacitat d’organització i resolució de situacions quotidianes.
* Bon tracte amb infants i joves, capacitat de treball en equip i adaptació.
* Domini del català.
* Es valorarà especialment disposar de la **titulació de director/a de lleure**.

description:
Barcelona, Spain

  

**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**

We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

**Job Details**

* People & Talent
* Barcelona, Spain
* Full-Time / Hybrid

**What you will do**

As a **Senior HR Business Partner** at Lighthouse, you'll partner with directors, vice presidents and leadership teams across Revenue and Marketing to shape people strategy and turn business priorities into practical action. This is a hands-on advisory role, combining workforce redesign and talent development with performance management and complex employee relations. Within an AI-native People & Talent function, you'll use people analytics and tools such as Claude to connect signals across clusters and bring leaders clear recommendations. You'll challenge assumptions, help leaders own their decisions and measure success by whether the business makes better decisions about its people because of your involvement.

**Where you will have impact**

* Partner with senior Revenue and Marketing leadership teams to shape people strategy and translate business priorities into quarterly people plans and targeted projects.
* Lead workforce redesign conversations as artificial intelligence changes roles, structures and capability needs, helping leaders decide what should change and put those decisions into practice.
* Partner closely with business leaders on change management and communication, shaping clear messages, preparing managers for team conversations and supporting employees through organisational transitions.
* Guide managers at all levels through feedback, performance improvement plans and performance calibration, in collaboration with People Operations.
* Advise on compensation, promotions, development and retention, addressing underperformance while helping strong performers succeed.
* Coach managers, strengthen leader onboarding and provide a confidential space for complex concerns, exercising judgment about when to escalate or involve others.
* Lead complex, sensitive employee relations cases as the senior escalation point for the portfolio, partnering with People Operations and involving Legal when needed.
* Challenge hiring profiles, levels, budgets and timelines constructively in partnership with Talent Acquisition.
* Synthesise engagement, attrition, performance, compensation and employee relations signals across clusters into business recommendations, using AI for analysis and pattern recognition and building simple dashboards where needed.
* Contribute to the design of performance, development, engagement and workforce planning programmes, bringing cluster insight into approaches that work in the business.
* Identify cross-cluster patterns that signal organisation-wide risk or opportunity and bring a clear recommendation to the Director of Talent Enablement.

**About our team**

You'll work closely with fellow HR Business Partners, People Operations and Talent Acquisition to support Revenue and Marketing leaders across Europe, the United States and Asia-Pacific. The work combines direct communication, practical manager support and a broader view of the business, with flexibility to organise your week around stakeholders in different time zones.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices.
* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.
* Payflow App: Access your earned salary in advance at no cost to you.
* Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery.
* Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription.
* Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
* Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* Experience partnering with Revenue teams in an international organisation, with an understanding of commercial pressures.
* Credibility advising directors and vice presidents on people strategy, organisation design and workforce change, alongside hands-on performance management experience.
* Clear, concise communication and senior stakeholder influence, including the ability to present recommendations, challenge assumptions and maintain a constructive position under pressure.
* Data storytelling skills that connect signals across clusters, distinguish local issues from organisation-wide patterns and build a business case for action.
* Understanding of how artificial intelligence reshapes roles, team structures and capability needs, and the ability to guide leaders through workforce redesign decisions.
* Generative AI fluency for synthesis, pattern recognition and insight generation, including basic analysis and HTML dashboards, with sound judgment about the limitations of AI outputs.
* Experience independently managing complex employee relations cases with significant business, legal or reputational dimensions, including knowing when to escalate or involve Legal.
* Ability to hold a multi-cluster portfolio in view while remaining hands-on, adapting to changing priorities and organising work across time zones.

**We welcome**

* International Revenue partnering experience from outside SaaS; SaaS experience is helpful, not required.
* Experience contributing to or designing HR frameworks, programmes or operating models.
* Familiarity with organisation design methods, including responsibility mapping, spans of control and role design principles.
* First-hand experience supporting a function through significant AI-driven transformation.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As a **Stoc** **k** **K** **eeper**you will be responsible for the activities of the Back of House , ensuring the creation of an environment wh ich allows efficiency, effectiveness, and excellence in routines and execution . You will work closely with the store team ensuring the right products are available on and close to the shop floor enabling an excellent client experience.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Maintain the organization of the stockroom to the highest standards with merchandise stored in a clear and organised way which allows the efficient flow between front and back of house.
* Manage the delivery of stock into the store, checking that it matches against the invoice and informing HQ / Inventory of any discrepancies.
* Unpack all deliveries placing stock safely and correctly in its designated location
* Control and manage the transfer of stock to and from the store and the return of stock to the Warehouse.
* Support the flow of stock and packaging between the back and front of house, ensuring the right products are available on the shop floor to improve efficiency and client experience.
* Ensure the team are promptly informed of new stock arrivals
* Plan and support periodic and mini stock takes, investigate and communicate any discrepancies to your Manager.
* Process all paperwork, reports and general administration connected with stock management.
* Work with internal teams (Visual, Merchandising, Press) making available their product requests.
* Support and coordinate the aftersales process (repairs, alteration, etc) to ensure an excellent client experience.
* Fully integrate and participate in the store activities such as morning briefings, relevant training, etc.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results
* Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury
* Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people
* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team
* A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture
* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Expansion Project Manager** to oversee the full expansion lifecycle for Impress, driving commercial growth through strategic partnerships and leading the delivery of flagship clinic construction projects worldwide. This role is responsible for identifying and closing real estate and B2B dental opportunities, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing CAPEX budgets, and executing end-to-end fit-out and site delivery.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Business Development & Real Estate Partnerships**

* Identify, prospect, and engage new real estate partners, including landlords, property owners, retail groups, and shopping centers.
* Pitch the Impress model to generate strong interest in hosting clinic locations.
* Build and manage an active pipeline of prospective sites, leading the full negotiation cycle through to contract signature.
* Develop and maintain an ongoing network of strategic partners, including landlords, commercial brokers, and investors.
* Represent Impress during meetings, site visits, and industry events to maximize expansion opportunities.

#### **2. Dental Partnership Development (B2B)**

* Prospect dental practices and orthodontists to establish strategic B2B partnerships.
* Present the Impress partnership model, tailor the pitch to partner needs, and execute agreements.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing partner practices to optimize ongoing collaboration.

#### **3. Construction & Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage flagship construction projects worldwide, owning each phase from design coordination and the tender process through construction, opening, and site handover.
* Manage the workload and output of regional teams involved in design and construction.
* Ensure all projects align with expansion forecasts, new opening schedules, and operational goals.
* Oversee the maintenance and remodeling of operational clinics to reflect strategic decisions, policy updates, and brand improvements.

#### **4. Budget Management**

* Build budgets prior to presentation to senior management for executive approval.
* Oversee comprehensive cost and budget management, evaluating and approving additional spending when necessary.

#### **5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with operations, finance, legal, marketing, and construction teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on expansion priorities and deadlines.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders (such as Country Managers and Medical Directors) to communicate regional needs, address requirements, and mitigate escalations.
* Escalate critical issues promptly to ensure all project milestones and opening dates are met.
* Identify potential operational, financial, or delivery risks early and implement corrective solutions.
* Deliver regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, contract negotiations, construction milestones, and upcoming clinic openings.

### **What you need to be successful:**

* Academic Background: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Industrial, Mechanical, Architectural, or related field).
* Experience: 5+ years in commercial real estate expansion, retail/network rollouts, or multi-site technical project management.
* Languages: **Native or Professional fluency in English** (additional languages are a plus).
* Mobility: **Willingness to travel frequently** for site visits, contractor inspections, partner meetings, and industry events.
* Commercial & Deal-Making Track Record: Proven background in B2B sales, real estate acquisition, lease negotiation, and partnership development with landlords, brokers, and healthcare professionals.
* End-to-End Project Delivery: Direct experience managing fit-outs and construction projects from initial design and tender to contractor oversight, site handover, and maintenance.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience formulating, tracking, and managing multi-site CAPEX budgets and construction cost accounts.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives, landlords, regional country managers, and medical directors.
* Project Management & Organization: Strong organizational skills with a track record of running parallel projects across multiple regions while hitting strict launch deadlines.

title: Store Manager Barcelona
description:
**Become our Store Manager and establish Hatstore in Barcelona**
----------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Help build Hatstore’s next international store**

2026 is an important year for Hatstore. Following our first international store launch, we’re taking the next step in our retail expansion and opening a new store in **Barcelona**.

Since launching in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Northern Europe’s leading e-commerce retailers for caps and headwear. Now we’re continuing to develop Hatstore as a brand and a place to meet, both offline and online. With our store in Barcelona, we want to create an inspiring destination for caps, fashion and a great customer experience.

For this exciting chapter, we’re looking for an **entrepreneurial, driven and hands-on Store Manager** who wants to help build our presence in Barcelona from the very beginning.

**About Hatstore**
------------------

Hatstore was founded on a genuine passion for caps, creativity and innovation—and those are still what drive us forward.

Today, we have more than 100 employees and sell to customers in 55 countries. Our range includes tens of thousands of caps, beanies and hats, including the option to create custom designs.

Our international retail expansion is an important part of Hatstore’s continued growth. We’re now looking for someone who wants to help make Barcelona an important part of our international store expansion.

**Your role as Store Manager**
------------------------------

As Store Manager of our new store in Barcelona, you’ll play a key role in establishing and developing Hatstore in the Spanish market.

You’ll be responsible for the store’s day-to-day operations, building and leading your team, and ensuring our customers have an experience that reflects the Hatstore brand.

You’ll also work closely with our head office in Sweden and be an important link between the local business and our international team.

This is an opportunity to be involved from the start, influence the way we work and lay the foundations for future Hatstore stores in other markets.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Store launch & development**  
Take part in planning, launching and developing our new store in Barcelona.

**Leadership & team**  
Recruit, onboard, develop and motivate the store team, and build a strong team culture.

**Sales & customer experience**  
Ensure a high level of service, create an inspiring store environment and actively work towards the store’s sales targets.

**Store operations & merchandise flow**  
Take responsibility for day-to-day operations, stock, merchandise flow, inventory and orders.

**Building the brand locally**  
Help build Hatstore’s local brand through social media, partnerships, events and other creative initiatives.

**Budget & performance follow-up**  
Manage the store’s budget and key performance indicators, and monitor and report results to our head office in Sweden.

**We believe you**
------------------

* Have experience in retail, for example as a Store Manager, shop manager, team leader or in a similar role
* Are a natural leader who enjoys developing people and building teams
* Have a strong customer focus and understand what makes a great in-store experience
* Are entrepreneurial, solution-oriented and used to taking responsibility
* Enjoy working hands-on and are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed
* Have a good understanding of retail and the local market in Barcelona
* Are comfortable with social media and enjoy creating content and building a brand
* Are proficient in English, as you’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden
* Are proficient in Spanish; Catalan language skills are an advantage
* Have a genuine interest in caps, fashion, sport and streetwear

You’re also someone who gets things done. You’re sociable, down-to-earth and confident in your leadership. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships, while also being clear and direct when needed.

An interest in American sports is an advantage, as a large part of our range is connected to MLB, NBA, NHL and NFL.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**A key role in Hatstore’s international expansion**  
You’ll be an important part of our continued international retail journey and help launch our new store in Barcelona.

**The opportunity to build something from the ground up**  
You’ll have plenty of scope to influence how the store develops, how the team works and how Hatstore establishes itself locally.

**International collaboration**  
You’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden and become part of a growing international team.

**Employee discounts**  
Enjoy attractive employee discounts across the Hatstore range.

**Annual wellness allowance**  
All employees receive an individual wellness allowance that can be used for activities such as sports and outdoor pursuits, or for spa, wellness and recovery.

**A growing and passionate organisation**  
Join us on an exciting growth journey where caps, creativity, entrepreneurship and people are at the heart of everything we do.

**Become part of Hatstore**
---------------------------

We’re looking for our next **Hatstar**, someone who wants to help make Hatstore a go-to destination for caps and headwear in Barcelona.

Does this sound like you? Apply today and become part of Hatstore’s international expansion.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Strategy & Transformation Specialist
description:
Quiénes somos

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor & Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.

We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.

Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1.8 billion passengers worldwide.

Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

**Qué esperamos**
-----------------

**Your mission :** Support the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office in defining, tracking and delivering the company’s strategic initiatives. You’ll provide high-quality analysis and reporting, and use data to challenge initiative owners so that initiatives move forward, are properly prioritised and deliver the expected impact.

**What you’ll do:**

**Analysis and reporting (c. 50%)**  
Half of your time will go into turning information into decisions. You’ll prepare the management reports, dashboards and materials that committees and senior leadership use to steer the business. You’ll also run ad hoc analyses whenever a strategic question comes up, from market sizing and benchmarks to business cases for new initiatives. Working closely with the Head of Strategy, you’ll help shape executive presentations that are clear, well-grounded and ready to support key decisions.

**Strategic initiative tracking (c. 50%)**  
The other half is about making sure strategy actually happens. You’ll manage the portfolio of strategic initiatives as you would a project, keeping a clear view of owners, milestones, KPIs, risks and status. You’ll meet regularly with directors and initiative owners, not just to collect updates but to ask the right questions: what is being done and why, what impact it is having, and what is holding progress back. When something goes off track, you’ll raise it with the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office, always bringing a proposal on how to get it back on course.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

You have 2–4 years of experience, ideally in strategy consulting, working on strategy, transformation or operations projects. You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a similar field, and your English is strong. A master’s degree is a plus, but not a requirement.

You’re highly analytical. You work comfortably with advanced Excel and build executive-level PowerPoint presentations, and experience with Power BI or an equivalent tool is highly valued. You know how to synthesise complex information and turn it into a clear, compelling storyline.

You’re also well organised. You track milestones rigorously and can manage several workstreams at once without losing sight of priorities.

Above all, you have the presence and confidence to challenge directors without creating friction. You’re results-oriented, proactive, and you don’t wait for problems to escalate before acting on them.

**Qué ofrecemos**
-----------------

* The opportunity to join an international team working on high-impact, technically demanding projects within the airport mobility sector.
* Hybrid working model: on-site in Mieres (Asturias) with partial remote work.
* Professional development within a specialized, expanding technical environment, as part of the TK Elevator group.
