title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.
* Build and maintain automations, Make scenarios and AI agents (for example Claude skills and MCP connections, ClickUp agents and AI assistants) that handle repetitive coordination: assignment checks, delivery QA, content safety and duration checks, reporting, onboarding messages and sample tracking.
* Test new AI and agentic tools for operations and creative production, and recommend what to adopt, with clear costs, risks and expected time saved.
* Keep a registry of every running automation and agent, with its purpose, owner and schedule. Make sure each one is monitored, documented and that failures surface quickly.
* Train the team to run and trust these workflows, so they keep working without depending on the person who built them.

ClickUp workspace

* Own the marketing ClickUp workspace: structure, lists, statuses, templates, dashboards, permissions, forms and native automations. Serve as the escalation point for ClickUp issues.
* Keep the workspace practical, accurate and usable as team needs change, with consistent processes across internal teams and external partners.
* Make sure tasks hold the information needed for execution, reporting and accountability.

Notion and operational documentation

* Own the architecture and maintenance of the marketing Notion workspace, including operational databases such as the ads delivery and creator sample trackers.
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.
* Update documentation whenever workflows change, so essential knowledge is easy to find and does not depend on any one person.

Reporting and operational performance

* Own marketing operations reporting and the accuracy of the trackers behind it.
* Keep visibility into assignments, production, delivery, backlog, capacity, onboarding and operational risks. Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.
* Define and maintain operational KPIs and their calculations with the relevant stakeholders, such as creative lead time and on-time delivery. Flag missing or inconsistent data before using it to assess performance.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement improvements that speed up execution, reduce avoidable revisions and improve resource use.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own the operational administration of the marketing tool stack (including Higgsfield, HeyGen, Claude, Make, Tagbox and other creative and AI tools): access, onboarding, offboarding, usage tracking and vendor coordination.
* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.
* Review software needs with team leads, coordinate renewals and resolve access or usage issues. Cut unnecessary costs and identify tools that make production faster.
* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

* Own the administration and documentation of creative rewards programs.
* Maintain eligibility rules, performance trackers, milestone records and calculation procedures. Validate the monthly close with the relevant performance and finance owners before rewards are approved for payment.
* Resolve questions on naming, attribution, iterations and eligibility consistently. Escalate exceptions and proposed rule changes to leadership.

Hiring, onboarding and offboarding coordination

* Partner with the Head of People and functional leads to identify hiring needs based on capacity, workload and performance.
* Keep visibility into open roles, expected start dates, onboardings, exits and resource gaps, and share a regular hiring operations recap.
* Coordinate skills-test logistics for creative candidates with the reviewing leads.
* Prepare new joiners operationally: workspace access, onboarding checklists and ClickUp templates, pod and channel assignments, welcome messages and training resources.
* Oversee the marketing side of offboarding so access is removed across every tool and shared account, and responsibilities and files are handed over properly.
* People owns recruitment and formal HR processes. You own the operational readiness and integration of marketing hires.

Admin team management

* Lead the marketing operations admins. Set weekly priorities, clarify ownership and review the accuracy and completeness of assignment, delivery, reporting and access-management work.
* Keep dependable daily coverage so recurring work continues through absences and staffing changes. Own escalations and fix the process when the same issue comes back.

Leadership support and continuous improvement

* Give the CEO a clear view of operational health, risks, capacity and decisions required.
* Support planning for new products, brands, teams, partners and growth initiatives. Assess operational requirements, resource implications and execution risks before rollout.
* Keep visibility into vendor costs, rewards liabilities and resource allocation, and provide accurate operational inputs for budget and profitability decisions.
* Proactively spot broken or missing processes, and take approved improvements from diagnosis through implementation, documentation and team adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Marketing priorities have clear owners and realistic deadlines. Teams know what to work on, approved assets move steadily toward launch and blockers surface early.
* Every asset that reaches media buying has passed its quality, safety and duration checks, and delivery records match reality.
* Manual coordination keeps shrinking as reliable workflows, automations and AI agents take it over, and the team knows how to run them.
* Creator, affiliate and social media programs run on clear processes, with samples, content, rights and results tracked end to end.
* ClickUp, Notion, automations and trackers stay accurate and useful. Leadership can see production status, capacity and risks without chasing updates.
* New hires join prepared pods with the right access and onboarding, and leavers are offboarded cleanly. External partners follow clear delivery processes.
* Tool usage, Higgsfield credits, costs and rewards are tracked reliably and reconcile to source.
* After the handover, the function runs independently, with you as the central owner of daily coordination, systems and operational improvement.

  
**Requirements**

What we're looking for

* Experience owning marketing operations, creative operations or project operations in a DTC e-commerce business or performance marketing agency.
* Strong hands-on ClickUp skills, including workspace design, dashboards, templates and automations, and confidence building and maintaining Notion documentation.
* A clear understanding of creative production workflows, paid media delivery, retention operations and cross-functional campaign execution.
* Experience coordinating distributed, multi-time-zone teams, managing competing deadlines and holding internal teams and external partners accountable.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, operational reporting, software costs and performance data, and the ability to spot unreliable data and fix the tracking behind it.
* A track record of building workflows and integrating AI into operations (for example Make, Zapier, Claude, ClickUp AI or custom agents), from first idea to a process the team uses every day.
* Experience overseeing creator, affiliate or social media programs, or working closely with the teams that run them.
* Clear written communication, sound judgment and the confidence to make routine operational decisions on your own.

Nice to have

* Experience with AI creative tools such as Higgsfield or HeyGen, and with managing credit-based tool budgets.
* Hands-on experience running creator, UGC or affiliate programs, including sample logistics and commission tracking.
* Experience operating through BFCM or other high-volume launch periods.

Above all, we need someone who takes full ownership, follows through and builds systems the team can rely on.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive monthly rate based on experience and ability to move fast
* Fully remote — no fixed location, flexible setup
* Access to real performance data and learning from how the creative system actually works at scale
* Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production and operations infrastructure

title: Senior Talent Acquisition
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 consultants and experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace people; it elevates us to where no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will develop more than skills—you will cultivate judgment. Your expertise will deepen with every system you architect, client challenge you solve, and deployment that builds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

* Partner with Managing Directors and senior stakeholders across Keyrus entities, turning business plans into clear hiring strategies backed by real market data

* Source, engage and attract top talent in Data, AI and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), with a primary focus on the French market and support for other EMEA markets when needed

* Recruit the profiles that power intelligent systems: AI and ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, data architects and AI consultants

* Use AI-enabled sourcing and talent intelligence tools (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI sourcing platforms, ATS automation) to identify and reach the right talent faster and more precisely

* Combine these tools with advanced human sourcing methods: headhunting, X-ray and Boolean search, growth hacking and deep networking

Qualifications/Certifications

* Proven success sourcing and hiring technical profiles in Data, AI, and Digital

* Experience recruiting for the French market

* Advanced sourcing skills: headhunting, Boolean / X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter

* Hands-on use of AI-enabled recruitment and talent intelligence tools in your daily work

* Fluent English and French (written and spoken)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience recruiting in other EMEA markets

* Any additional language (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch)

* Background in Resource Management (in-house, MSP or RPO), ideally with nearshore/offshore recruitment experience

* Experience recruiting EPM profiles

* Experience with recruitment analytics and reporting dashboards

* Experience recruiting for consulting firms or professional services

**What Makes You Successful**

* Clear, persuasive communication with candidates and senior stakeholders across cultures

* The ability to influence hiring decisions with market data and a well-argued point of view

* Commercial awareness: you understand how a consulting business runs and why the right hire at the right time matters

* The judgment to combine AI-driven efficiency with personal, high-quality candidate experience

* High energy, curiosity and the drive to keep raising the bar on how Keyrus recruits

**Rewards – What We Offer at Keyrus**

* A full-time contract

* Benefits and package depending on your location

* A team that supports and guides you from day one

* Plenty of challenges and opportunities to keep developing your skills

* An environment built on trust, openness and collaboration

**What We Stand For**

* Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

* Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

* Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

* Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

**Our Hiring Process**

We keep our process clear and respectful of your time:

* Interview with the Intake Manager: a deep dive into your recruitment experience, sourcing approach, and use of AI and data in your work

* Initial conversation with the Intake team: to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about us

* Practical exercise: you walk us through your sourcing and market-mapping strategy for a Data & AI role

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of an intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model (HOM), we architect reliable:

* Intelligence Foundations,

* Human in Command governance,

* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 3,000 employees across 30 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

title: Personal Assistant to the Director of Policy, Development and Advocacy (PDA)
description:
The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

ISGlobal is seeking a motivated Personal Assistant to provide administrative and secretarial support to the Director of the Policy, Development and Advocacy (PDA) Department. The position will play a key role in managing the Director’s agenda, correspondence, travel and events, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the Director’s activities.

The Personal Assistant will report to the Director of PDA and work in close coordination with the Head of Director’s Office, contributing to the effective functioning of the Area and to clear, timely communication with ISGlobal’s departments and external partners.

In parallel, this person will contribute to the organization of the PDA team’s internal events, coordination meetings and retreats, and to the logistics of high-level visits and external events.

### **MAIN DUTIES**

* Provide day-to-day secretarial and administrative support to the Director of PDA.
* Manage the Director’s agenda and the scheduling of meetings, appointments, calls and videoconferences, and monitor the Director’s email and calls, flagging urgent matters.
* Prepare and circulate meeting agendas, supporting documents and minutes, and follow up on agreed actions and deadlines.
* Draft, proofread and format correspondence, briefing notes, presentations and reports in English, Spanish and Catalan.
* Plan and organise the Director’s national and international travel, including visas and invitation letters, and prepare travel reports and expense justifications for the Accounting Department.
* Support the organisation of internal events (coordination meetings, retreats) and of external events and high-level visits, including logistics and communications to participants.
* Provide administrative support in the management of purchases, supplies and service requests for the PDA team, as well as in procedures for new staff, interns and visitors, keeping documents and files organised and confidential.
* Support the development of processes and templates for the Director’s Office, and perform other tasks as requested by the Director of PDA.

**AUXILIAR TASKS**

This job description reflects the present requirements of the post but may evolve at any time in the future as duties and responsibilities change and/or develop providing there is appropriate consultation with the post-holder.

This job description is not a definitive or exhaustive list of responsibilities but identifies the key responsibilities and tasks of the post holder. The specific objectives of the post holder will be subject to review as part of the individual professional assessment process.

### **SKILLS**

* Time management and ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
* Discretion, confidentiality and professionalism.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Must have self-motivation, eagerness to grow professionally and commitment to self-development.
* Clear written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills at all levels.
* Teamwork and collaboration.
* Proactivity and autonomy.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
* Flexibility and adaptability.
* Empathy.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to work in an international, multicultural environment.
* Excellent Excel and Microsoft Office products.
* Working knowledge mainstream AI tools and a willingness to use them to improve everyday work processes.

The post holder will adhere to ISGlobal principles contained in **People management policy, including Equity, diversity and health safety**. The post holder will respect, and be accountable to ensure ISGlobal policies and procedures.

### **TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum education: Higher education in Secretarial Studies, Administration or related field. A university degree, as well as postgraduate studies, will be considered an asset.
* Proven experience (at least 5 years) as a secretary, executive assistant or personal assistant supporting senior management, preferably in an international, non-profit or research environment.
* Willingness to work in a collaborative, international and multicultural environment, in an institute committed to improving global health.

### **KEY RESULTS EXPECTED**

* Effective coordination and resolution of the Director’s daily operations, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows. Clear, timely, and professional internal communication between the Director’s Office and all departments of ISGlobal, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Effective management of external relations and communications, including the preparation and dissemination of relevant content, high-level visits, and interactions with partners. To support the Director’s agenda, priorities, and operational activities to enable timely decision-making, strategic execution, and overall excellence in the functioning of the Area.

### **LANGUAGE LEVEL**

* Proficiency in Catalan, English, and Spanish.

### **CONDITIONS**

* Contract: full time, permanent contract
* Salary: 30.656€ gross annual
* Work-Life Balance: 36 days off per year (23 vacation days + 13 personal days)
* Start date: as soon as possible

### **HOW TO APPLY**

Applicants must complete the application form and upload a CV and a Cover Letter. Each document must be clearly named with the candidate’s name and surname.

Applications will remain open until 10th of November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates may be contacted and interviewed as applications are received. Interviews may take place during the application period.

We encourage diverse applications, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, physical abilities, and political beliefs.

### **SELECTION PROCESS**

The selection process is designed in two phases:
  
1- Interview phase of a technical nature, with the team that requires the incorporation. To assess the person's skills and CV.  
2 - Meeting with HR with the finalist(s) to finish assessing the profile and discuss contractual and institutional issues.

If needed any technical test could be passed. A Psychological Competency Evaluation Test will be required for the structural or transversal positions.

In accordance with the OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for every vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will start the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. A profile questionnaire as well as a technical exercise may be required during the process.

description:
**About the Team**

We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers.

We’re looking for a product-oriented **Senior iOS Engineer** to join our **iOS team**.

You will contribute to our flagship trading platform, used by millions of users worldwide.

The project focuses on a major redesign, improving the application architecture, delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, and developing new business features to further enhance the product.

In this role, you’ll work on application architecture, platform-level solutions, and key user-facing features. You’ll have the opportunity to influence the technical direction of our iOS application, improve existing solutions, and contribute directly to its product evolution.

Our team includes 3 iOS Developers, 3 QA Engineers, and a Team Leader.

We follow Agile and Scrum methodologies with 2-week sprints and daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST.

We also follow an AI-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including code development, code reviews, debugging, and problem-solving.

### **Project Description**

* Programming Language: All code is written exclusively in Swift. There are only a few classes written in Objective-C, which are necessary for interoperability with C++ code.

* User Interface: Legacy code uses Storyboards and NIB files, while new code is written programmatically. One of the current priorities is redesigning the application and delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families.

* Data Storage: CoreData is used for data management. Experience with multithreading is required.

* Unit Tests: The Nimble framework is used for unit testing.

* UI Tests: Cucumber is used for user interface testing. The team is also transitioning towards native Swift-based test automation.

* Compatibility: The minimum supported iOS version is 15.

* Build System: Tuist is used for dependency management and project building.

* C++ Integration: Occasionally, reading and integrating C++ code is required.

* Reactive Programming: RxSwift is actively used in the project.

* Architecture: New code follows the MVVM architectural pattern with the use of Coordinators.

* Modularity: The project uses a multi-module architecture with more than 40 modules, and the number of modules is constantly increasing.

* Legacy Code: The project includes legacy code that needs to be maintained and improved. It is important to understand existing implementations, refactor them when necessary, and introduce changes safely without disrupting existing functionality.

* AI Integration: AI tools are actively integrated into everyday development workflows, supporting code development, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.

### **Tasks**

* Develop and maintain our iOS application, including implementing new business features and improving existing functionality.
* Contribute to the redesign and modernization of the iOS product, including adaptive UI implementation across different screen sizes and device families.
* Design and improve application architecture and platform-level solutions within a multi-module environment.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, handle network requests, and implement WebSocket and other socket-based connections.
* Work with CoreData, multithreading, and asynchronous operations to ensure application performance and stability.
* Maintain, refactor, and improve legacy code while ensuring compatibility with existing functionality.
* Develop and maintain unit and UI tests to ensure application quality and reliability.
* Troubleshoot and debug technical issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement appropriate solutions.
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with designers, product managers, QA Engineers, and other developers throughout the development lifecycle.

**Cloud / M365 Security Engineer**

  

**Role ID:** **TG-001-3**

  

**Role Background**  
  
The Cloud Computing Support – Expert Support (ICT Security Officer) will provide highly specialized ICT security services in support of the client, covering the ICT environment and systems defined in the overarching Service Level Agreement (SLA) between client and the Office, including the management of a dedicated Microsoft 365 tenant.  
Services shall be provided in accordance with applicable ICT governance, standards, and security policies, commensurate with the available capacity to ensure reasonable service coverage (5x8 during defined working hours), complemented by a duty officer modality outside working hours under specifically defined conditions to support and respond to urgent security-specific needs, including incident response.

Expected outputs at this level include, inter alia, highly specialized technical security support and project-wide proposals.

  

**Service Scope**

**Cloud & Collaboration Environment**

* Microsoft 365 tenant: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and associated collaboration workloads.

* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): identities, authentication, conditional access, and privileged accounts within the covered tenant.

* Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, and Defender for Identity, as deployed.

* Microsoft Purview and related compliance, audit, and data-protection capabilities, as applicable.

  

**Security Monitoring & Response Systems**

* Designated ICT security systems and services generating security reports and alerts for the covered environment.

* Threat intelligence sources and platforms relevant to the covered environment.

* Vulnerability identification and assessment capabilities applicable to the covered ICT environment and systems.

  

**Resilience & Recovery**

* Operational Resilience (OR) controls implemented and maintained by relevant operations teams across the covered ICT environment and systems.

* Disaster recovery plans and Disaster Recovery Exercises (DRX) performed by the respective operations teams.

  

**Technical Knowledge**

* Microsoft 365 & Cloud Security

* In-depth expertise in Microsoft 365 security administration: Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365 (anti-phishing, safe links/attachments, mail-flow protection), and Defender for Endpoint.

* Microsoft Entra ID security: identity protection, risky sign-in/user investigation, conditional access design, MFA enforcement, and privileged identity management.

* Investigation and remediation of compromised accounts, suspicious e-mails, business e-mail compromise (BEC), and other cloud-borne threats.

* Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent cloud SIEM/SOAR platforms: analytics rules, incident triage, automation/playbooks, and watchlists.

* Advanced hunting using Kusto Query Language (KQL) and other environment-specific threat-hunting capabilities.
  

**Security Operations & Incident Response**

* Security incident response methodologies aligned with recognized frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-61), including containment, eradication, and recovery.

* Digital forensics analysis: evidence collection and preservation, log and artifact analysis, and root-cause determination for cloud and hybrid environments.

* Design, documentation, and continuous improvement of detection and response methods, procedures, runbooks, and tooling.

* Threat intelligence handling: collection, analysis, sharing, and coordination of recommended mitigation measures (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK mapping, IOC management).
  

**Vulnerability & Risk Management**

* Security assessment of ICT environments and systems throughout their life cycle, including configuration reviews against security baselines and benchmarks (e.g., CIS, Microsoft Secure Score).

* Vulnerability verification, prioritization (e.g., CVSS-based), remediation guidance, and validation of corrective measures.

* Preparation of security advisories, notifications, and remediation recommendations referencing relevant security updates.

  

**Governance, Advisory & Awareness**

* Security architecture and configuration-baseline advisory for system design, development, and modification in alignment with applicable architectural standards and security policies.

* Development of security guidelines, standards, and policy inputs with organization-wide impact, consistent with the Expert Support level.

* Preparation of end-user security awareness materials and support to awareness campaigns.

* Security reporting within established governance and reporting frameworks, including incident and status reporting.
  

**Resilience & Recovery**

* Identification and assessment of Operational Resilience (OR) controls commensurate with business requirements.

* Disaster recovery planning, coordination, and support to Disaster Recovery Exercises (DRX).

  

**Role Duties and Responsibilities**

  

The ICT Security Officer will perform, but not be limited to, the following duties in accordance with applicable ICT governance, standards, and security policies:

* Monitor, verify, and escalate security reports and alerts generated by designated ICT security systems and services.

* Monitor and respond to Microsoft 365 security incidents, including compromised accounts, suspicious e-mails, and other threats affecting the tenant.

* Conduct proactive threat-hunting activities using environment-specific capabilities, including M365 security tools and other relevant technologies, as appropriate.

* Establish, document, and maintain methods, procedures, and tools appropriate to the environment to support threat detection and response.

* Perform security incident response activities, including forensics analysis, and coordinate and advise on appropriate response measures for incidents detected by the team or reported/escalated to it from other sources.

* Monitor, share, and act on relevant threat intelligence, and coordinate the implementation of recommended measures where applicable to minimize exposure to associated risks.

* Perform regular security assessments of the ICT environment and systems throughout their life cycle (as appropriate) to identify potential security issues, provide guidance on effective remediation, and help minimize risk exposure.

* Issue security advisories and notifications to alert relevant operational teams to vulnerabilities affecting ICT systems, providing remediation recommendations including references to relevant security updates to effectively and promptly reduce exposure to associated risks.

* Verify vulnerabilities reported through various sources, notify relevant teams, provide appropriate recommendations for prompt remediation, and confirm the effectiveness of implemented corrective measures.

* Provide security-specific advice to operations teams to support system design, development, modification, and security configuration baselines in alignment with applicable architectural standards and security policies.

* Prepare and issue end-user awareness materials and support awareness initiatives to strengthen users' ability to recognize and respond appropriately to security threats.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Market Development Manager — EMEA
description:
#### **About the Role:**

Hearing care is consolidating. Regional chains are becoming national ones, national ones are going multi-country, and most of them are still running on software that cannot take them there. Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide — no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.

**Your mandate:**

* **Market selection:** build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.
* **Market entry:** create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.
* **Demand:** turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.

#### **What You Will Do:**

* Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.
* EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.
* Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.
* Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.
* Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.
* Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.
* Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.
* Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.
* Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.
* Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.
* Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.
* A self-directed mindset: you will be creating this territory, not inheriting it.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Remote-first and async-friendly with a flat organizational structure.
* A modern IT environment: leading AI tools, HubSpot CRM and the means to automate your go-to-market.
* A real career path and leadership track, with development and certification support.
* A global, diverse team across 30+ nationalities.
* A product held to ISO 13485 and EU MDR, and a mission that matters: do this well and more people hear better, sooner.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

We look forward to your application! (***please submit your CV in English and a few lines on why this role interests you***)

*Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create a diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition
description:

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

**Our vision**

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

**About us**

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

**WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission**

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

**HOW you will contribute to the company**

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

* You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
* You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
* You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
* You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
* You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

**WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane**

**Within one month:**

* You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
* You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
* You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

**Within 3 months:**

* You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
* You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
* You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

**Within 6 months:**

* You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
* You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
* You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

**And beyond**: **the data team will continue growing with the company**

Which means:

* Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
* Increased accountability in project leadership
* Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

**Who are we looking for?**

You’re the right candidate if you:

* Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
* Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
* Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
* You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
* Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
* Are fluent in English (French is a plus)

**What does the recruitment process look like?**

* A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
* A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
* A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
* An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

**What do we do to make your work life easier**

Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

You’ll have a competitive compensation package

You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

title: AI Security Governance Architect
description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions? At **Plain Concepts**, our **AI Security Studios** team helps organizations adopt AI securely and responsibly by defining how risks, controls and responsibilities should be managed throughout the AI lifecycle.

As an **AI Security Governance Architect**, you will help design and operationalize cybersecurity governance frameworks for **AI, Generative AI and agentic AI**, working closely with security, architecture and business teams. You will act as a **cybersecurity subject matter expert for AI governance**, translating emerging AI risks into practical **security controls, requirements, processes and architecture patterns** that organizations can actually implement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Define and evolve AI security governance frameworks**, covering AI use case registration, risk classification, security controls, approvals, exceptions, monitoring and periodic reassessment.
* **Align AI security governance with recognized standards and regulations**, including NIST AI RMF, NIST Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the EU AI Act.
* **Assess AI, GenAI and agentic AI use cases from a cybersecurity perspective**, considering risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, identity and access management, excessive agent permissions, model exposure, third-party AI services, data residency and AI supply chain risks.
* **Translate AI risks into practical security controls**, including security policies, technical requirements, architecture patterns, guardrails, evidence requirements, ownership and acceptance criteria.
* **Define security requirements and architecture patterns for different AI scenarios**, including internal copilots, Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG systems, AI agents, ML models, vendor AI solutions and low-code/no-code AI automations.
* **Integrate AI security governance with existing security tooling and processes**, including solutions such as HiddenLayer, Sentra and Zenity, as well as GRC, IAM, DLP, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, CMDB and data governance environments.
* **Define and improve AI security governance deliverables**, including AI security control frameworks, use case classification models, security requirements, architecture patterns, risk acceptance processes, security review templates, KPI/KRI dashboards and maturity roadmaps.

  
**Requirements**  

* **8+ years of experience in cybersecurity**, with a strong background in security governance, security architecture, risk management, AppSec or Cloud Security.

* **Strong understanding of AI and GenAI security risks**, including LLM application security, prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, RAG security, AI agent permissions, model/API exposure, model supply chain and third-party AI services.
* **Experience designing and operationalizing security governance and control frameworks**, with the ability to turn policies and risk requirements into practical controls, processes and security requirements.
* **Knowledge of AI security and governance frameworks**, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and related AI risk and security standards.
* **Ability to work across security, architecture and business teams**, translating complex cybersecurity risks into clear requirements and recommendations for both technical and executive stakeholders.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, with the ability to create executive-ready materials as well as detailed security and control documentation.

* Knowledge of cloud security architecture, Secure SDLC/DevSecOps, DSPM, GRC or AI-related SOC monitoring.
* Familiarity with tools such as HiddenLayer, Sentra, Zenity, Wiz, Microsoft Purview, Defender, CSPM/CWPP, DLP or SIEM/SOAR platforms.
* Knowledge of third-party AI risk management and security control evidence automation.

description:

We are looking for a **Middle ML & AI Engineer** to join us as part of our team.

### **About the role**

PitchBook’s Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for using machine learning, statistical modeling, and natural language processing (NLP) to collect a high volume of data for the PitchBook Platform and surface insights for the capital markets. This role will also serve as a resource and mentor for junior members of the team. A strong motivation to succeed is critical, and everyone has the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of our team.

**About the project**

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others. Features of PitchBook: Advanced search / Discovery & insights / Company profiles / Workflow & efficiency / Financials, and many more.

**Team:** Engineering Manager, 6 MLE’s.

**Work Environment:** The role offers a flexible work schedule, allowing you to adapt your working hours with the requirement to attend all team meetings. The team follows a Scrum-based Agile methodology.

**Technical Stack:** Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Spacy, LangChain, LangGraph etc.

### **As a qualified expert, You will**

* **Work with GenAI & LLMs:** Design, develop, and fine-tune generative AI models using transformer architectures. Implement advanced techniques to create practical solutions for real-world challenges.
* **Use Modern Toolkits:** Leverage frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith to build automated pipelines and intelligent agents. Integrate these tools with vector databases for efficient similarity search and real-time analysis.
* **Extract Data Insights:** Process and analyze large volumes of unstructured data using embeddings and statistical modeling to identify meaningful insights.
* **Build Scalable Systems:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create production-grade ML systems that handle real-time, high-volume data processing.
* **Mentor & Lead:** Act as a mentor for junior team members and stay updated on trends in Agentic AI, transformer models, and generative systems.
* **Collaborate & Communicate:** Work with Product and Engineering teams to improve data management and support innovation. Present complex analyses clearly and effectively.
* **Tech Stack & Focus Areas:** Work with generative AI and transformer models, integrating frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith to automate workflows and build intelligent systems. Use PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Spacy to build NLP pipelines. Implement vector databases for high-dimensional data embeddings and develop hybrid models to extract insights from diverse data sources.

### **We’re looking for you if you have**

* **Educational Background:** You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.
* **Experience:** You bring 4+ years of production experience in the ML field, with a track record in developing transformer-based models and deploying them in scalable systems.
* **Technical Expertise:** Proficient in Python and machine and deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, Spacy, or others; experienced in natural language processing and modern LLM-based techniques; experience with full ML lifecycle, data preprocessing, training, evaluation stage, and monitoring techniques; skilled with SQL and data extraction methods.
* **Innovative Thinker:** You thrive on solving complex problems and are always exploring new trends in Generative AI.
* **Collaborator & Communicator:** You’re an excellent communicator able to collaborate and professionally express your thoughts to team members, other engineering teams, and stakeholders.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to financial services, investment banking, venture capital, or private equity is nice to have.
* **Languages: English** —Upper-Intermediate or higher; **Ukrainian** —fluent/native**.**

### **What’s in it for You**

**Reveal great tech solutions**

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

**Experience an agile and flexible working environment**

Work fully remote around the globe, or in a hybrid work model from our office hubs which are equipped with everything needed for comfortable work. Enjoy a flexible working schedule and create work and rest balance for yourself. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, focusing on lasting cooperation and high-performance culture.

**Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth**

Take advantage of performance review and career path. Elevate your skills with mentorship program, personal development plan, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

**Feel cared about**

Be among like-minded people and feel supported with collaboration, open communication and mutual respect. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values.

title: Deputy CDO
description:
**Deputy Chief Data Officer (Deputy CDO)**  
Cyprus / Worldwide – Remote (Any Location) · Full-Time · Research Center

Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG's products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We're proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Deputy Chief Data Officer for the Research Center of the Core Business Unit — the #2 role in a data function that directly drives company P&L.

We see the Deputy CDO as a full-fledged successor to the CDO: a leader who can take over the function when needed. Together, the CDO and the Deputy CDO make sure we do the right things and that these things reach measurable results fast and predictably. The Deputy CDO owns execution across the function, leads part of the strategic initiatives personally and works directly with C-level executives. This is not a chief of staff or program manager role: we need a leader who goes deep into the substance of analytics, ML, data engineering, marketing analytics, UX research and experimentation, and turns strategy into business results.

**Your main tasks will be:**

* Lead part of the Research Center's strategic initiatives end-to-end — from business case and prioritization to delivery and measurable impact.
* Work directly with C-level executives and business heads: align priorities, commitments and trade-offs, negotiate resources and timelines with clear, numbers-based arguments.
* Own the execution of key cross-functional initiatives across the Research Center: data platform and BigQuery migration, ML projects with complex dependencies, experimentation process, AI for analytics, UX research, data quality / SLA / freshness.
* Unblock stalled projects: when work is stuck between teams or has no clear owner, define scope, owners, next steps and blockers, escalate early and drive it to delivery.
* Manage resources and backlog across teams: prioritize by business value, allocate capacity, manage dependencies between ML, backend, product and analytics, stop or rethink initiatives that don't deliver.
* Build and run the operating system of the function: monthly reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retros, commitment tracking, escalation process and a single status dashboard — working with or without any single person.
* Measure everything in business terms: translate initiatives into numbers, benefits and expected impact; track ROI and results against plan; make sure “we shipped the task” is never mistaken for “the business changed”.
* Strengthen the team leads (Product Analytics, Data Engineering, ML, UX Research): help them set goals, prioritize, give honest feedback and grow as managers.
* Own the operational health of the function: data freshness, platform uptime, ML platform stability, delivery predictability and experimentation throughput.

**We expect from you:**

* 7+ years in data, analytics or ML in product tech companies, including 4+ years in leadership roles managing strong specialists and team leads.
* Experience as a CDO, Deputy CDO or Head of Data / Analytics in a mid-size or large product organization is highly desirable.
* Readiness and ambition to grow into the CDO role: strategic thinking combined with the willingness to own day-to-day execution.
* A broad understanding of all Research Center domains: product and marketing analytics, A/B testing and experimentation, the ML lifecycle from idea to production, data platforms, data quality and SLA, BI / self-service, unit economics. Hands-on depth in at least one of them.
* Proven track record of execution: concrete examples of delivering complex cross-functional data / ML projects to measurable results.
* Strong operational management skills: project decomposition, planning, resource and backlog management, risk management, clean escalation, running many parallel initiatives.
* Business leader mindset: thinks in numbers, benefits and business impact; understands trade-offs between speed, quality, value and risk; always asks “what changed for the business?”.
* Experience working with and negotiating with C-level executives: confident, precise with numbers, persuasive through facts.
* Influence without formal authority: earns trust through competence and results; able to push hard and handle conflict without becoming toxic.
* Systematic, disciplined and persistent; comfortable with ambiguity and multitasking.
* Fluent Russian and English are a must.

**What do we offer:**

* REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full time;
* The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment;
* Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
* 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
* Compensation of kindergarten or school fees for your child;
* Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
* 50% payment for professional training, international conferences and meetings;
* Corporate discount for English language lessons;
* Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor's fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
* Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
* Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for merch, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!

title: Middle UI/UX Designer
description:

title: Event Production Manager
description:
**Event Production Manager**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

You will work directly with the Head of Events on the production of Fun Business Days and the Fourvenues international events calendar, making sure every event lands on date and on budget, and ends in meetings the sales team can follow up on.

**Location:** Valencia or Madrid, Spain (hybrid model)

**Reporting to:** Head of Events

**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Produce every event in the calendar end to end: brief, timeline, suppliers, build, on-site delivery and teardown, across Spain, the US, Italy and the Netherlands.
* Coordinate the production of Fun Business Days, the industry congress we run in Valencia: 3,000 attendees, 4 stages, 40 stands and 50 speakers, with a production agency by your side.
* Run several productions in parallel, in different cities, and hold every one of them to the same standard.
* Negotiate and manage suppliers, venues, agencies and freelancers, and hold them to the brief.
* Keep every event on date and on budget, and flag variance before it happens.
* Own the detail that decides whether an attendee has a good time: signage, flow, timings, hospitality and contingency. From a 3,000-person congress to a dinner for 8.
* Measure every event: log every contact and every meeting in HubSpot, and report cost per attendee and cost per qualified meeting.
* Brief Design and Audiovisual early, book the team’s travel and accommodation ahead of time, and keep the supplier map, the production playbook and the project board up to date.
* After every event, propose what to repeat, what to change and what to drop, with the numbers in front of you.
* Use AI tools to speed up the repeatable parts of every production (supplier comparisons, run of show, attendee communications, post-event reports), with sound judgment on what needs human review.

**What we need from you...**

* 5+ years producing events, including at least 2 on multi-supplier productions.
* Experience on the production side of industry conferences, live events or festivals.
* You have run several productions at once, at least one outside your home city.

* B2B marketing experience and an understanding of how an event turns into pipeline.
* Production and floorplan tools.
* A supplier network in Valencia, Madrid or Miami.
* Italian.
* Having produced outside Spain.

* Salary based on candidate's skills and experience.
* Annual bonuses for those who significantly contribute to Fourvenues' success.
* A vision and team that will inspire you to excel and reach the next level in your career development.
* Continuous training we want you to stay at the forefront of technology and grow your skills through regular internal training.
* MacBook laptop and high-resolution monitors to maximize your potential.
* Hybrid work model (3+2): three days in the office and two from home if that’s where you feel most productive although we're confident that the environment and the team will make you enjoy being at the office more than you’d expect.
* Flexible working hours. Organize your workday between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, as long as you meet scheduled commitments.
* Private health insurance to promote your peace of mind and well-being.
* Optional flexible benefits plan, such as dining, childcare, transportation, and discounts with major brands.
* Extra vacation days for special occasions like birthdays, holidays, or unique events.

**About Fourvenues**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

At Fourvenues, we scale aggressively while maintaining disciplined unit economics and a long-term vision. We have the privilege of collaborating with renowned brands such as Pacha, BRESH, Cova Santa, BCM, Magic Room HK, Blackworks, Sonorama Medellin, Opium, and Gossip Doha. And we’re continuously signing new partnerships every month, presenting challenges that push us to deliver outstanding service.

If you’re at a point in your career where you’re ready to make an impact, unlock your full potential, and join a rapidly expanding company, this is the place for you!
