title: Product Manager
description:
### **About our Crew**

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a **Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance** to join our Product team in Barcelona.

### **The role**

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our **monetization and compliance roadmap**. You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our **revenue and contribution margin**, while keeping the product compliant on **tax and invoicing**.

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with **finance, data, legal and operations**, with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

**The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers**, 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

### **What floats your boat**

* **Build a point of view:** you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).
* **Vision & Roadmap:** you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.
* **Compliance by design:** you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.
* **Data-driven decisions:** you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.
* **Decision making:** you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.
* **Fail fast, learn fast:** you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

### **What you bring aboard**

* Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.
* You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.
* A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.
* Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.
* You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
* Fluent or bilingual in English.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.
* Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.
* Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

### **The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.
* Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

### **️** **What awaits you on board**

* A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;
* Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;
* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;
* Team-building activities;
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract:** Permanent position

**Start date:** ASAP

### **Ready to join?**

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all.

title: Head of Product - AI x EdTech - French fluent
description:
**This isn’t another product job.**

**It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System** (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.

**Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.**

**A chance to build an AI-native Product Department**

You’ll be working with **the most complex data in the world : the human mind.**

* **Impact :** you strive to make a real difference in the company's growth, and not be a number in a big organization
* **Mission :** knowing your greatness left a mark in people's lives, through technology and behavioral science

**At Paradox, we believe that greatness is trainable.**

**That’s why** we want to empower people at scale by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

* **Human Intelligence** (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* **Structured Intelligence** (protocols, mental models, rituals),
* **Technological Intelligence** (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: **Paradox OS**.

**This is why we are looking for a Head of product to make Paradox a category-defining global brand loved for its product.**

This is a full-time position from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Paris or Lisbon or remotely anywhere in the world.

**OUR BELIEFS**
---------------

We believe self-help is broken.  
Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At **Paradox**, we believe people deserve more.  
More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a **system that knows them**, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that **every human learns differently**, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.  
It can **translate insight into transformation**, through **AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding**.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should **change how you live, think, and create.**

**OUR VISION**
--------------

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche - a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations *be our* marketing.

**OUR AI-NATIVE AMBITION**
--------------------------

We want to build an AI-native company, with agents in every department doing the work alongside our people.

In product, that means building a self-learning AI for product management: a system that learns from every user signal, experiment and release, and gets sharper at deciding what to build next.

For our clients, it means a self-learning AI that serves them through psychology and coaching, and gets better at helping each person change with every interaction.

You won’t just use AI tools: you’ll help design the agents, loops and feedback systems that make Paradox learn faster than anyone else.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

-

As **Head of Product**, you’ll be the **architect of a new category**, transforming growth into a living ecosystem powered by **AI, behavioral science, and design**.

You won’t just build features, you’ll **craft experiences that rewire behavior**.

You’re the **architect bringing clarity** between vision and execution, the person who turns “we should build this” into “it’s live, here’s the data and tangible impact.”

Every product cycle you lead will integrate:

* **Protocols** : guided frameworks grounded in psychology that rewire perception, emotion, and action.
* **Pods** : human connection, accountability, and shared rituals.
* **Loops** : adaptive, AI-powered coaching cycles that evolve with each user.
* **Personalization** : experiences that feel uniquely theirs, every time.

Going from a successful personal brand, to an international tech-driven iconic brand, is far from easy. It will be messy, chaotic - requiring constant iterations on MVPs and innovation in tech. Therefore to achieve this here are :

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

-

### **1. Make AI-native a way of building the company**

* Translate the founder’s strategic vision into a clear product strategy.
* Build and maintain the roadmap that connects business goals, user outcomes, and technological innovation.
* Ensure every feature supports the evolution of the Paradox ecosystem: Loops, PX Agents, Protocols, Membership.

### **2. User Understanding & Behavioral Insight**

* Be obsessed with user problems : talk to users weekly, analyze patterns, and identify where transformation breaks.
* Turn insights from behavioral science, coaching psychology, and learning design into actionable product hypotheses.
* Design loops, feedback, and rituals that make growth tangible.
* build for both the heart (inspiration) and the brain (structure).

### **3. Build, Ship, Learn Fast, create AI Loops**

* Apply Lean Startup methodology and scientific thinking to validate ideas through MVPs, not opinions.
* Design experiments and measurable success metrics before building.
* Iterate on a weekly basis on new hypothesis

### **4. AI Native Product Analytics & Impact Measurement**

* Define and track product success metrics (activation, retention, transformation rates).
* Connect data to business KPIs, know how your product drives lifetime value, not just engagement.
* We don’t track metrics just for internal dashboards, we track them also to prove transformation.
* Help marketing leverage this data to fuel authentic, evidence-based storytelling — showing the world *what real transformation looks like.*

### **5. Blend emotions (“open the heart of people”) with precision (“build loops, scoring, protocols”).**

* Create a visceral experience that translates into emotions of inspiration, awe from users.
* **Use a Science-backed, Cinematic, Contrarian style :** Every product touchpoint should be grounded in behavioral science, expressed with cinematic beauty, and challenge conventions

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**
-----------------------

-

**Experience :**

* 3–6 years as a Product Manager / Product Owner in EdTech, SaaS, or Consumer Tech.
* Bonus: experience in **AI-driven products**, **learning design**, or **personal development platforms.**
* You’ve shipped at least one major feature or product end-to-end, and can show measurable results.
* Uses Figma comfortably, prototypes directly.

**Traits :**

* **Craft-obsessed :** You get things done, you love to work much beyond 9-5, you have a doer mentality, a bias for outcomes and want to be a beast in your field
* **User & Impact Obsessed:** You think in outcomes, not outputs, you care about transformation.
* **Analytical & System Thinker:** You can turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, metrics, and roadmap.
* **Digital & AI savvy :** you’re able to build AI Agents (if not, you demonstrate ability to learn while applying).
* **Cross-disciplinary Curiosity:** You speak both tech and human; You can move from **vision to spreadsheet to Figma**

### **Language**

**French** : native

**English**: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

-

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.  
If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.  
If you build to deliver, not to *elevate* — wrong mission.

Surface-level Vision Alignment : you like the idea of Paradox but doesn’t want to *get* the depth. Paradox is design-led; you must *touch the product*, not just manage it.

If you’re obsessed with systems, psychology, and design…  
If you dream of using AI to amplify what makes us human…

**WHY JOIN US**

Build a product that fuses **neuroscience, design, and AI** to reinvent how humans grow.

The chance to build a product that could redefine human potential.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the **100 000 Dreams Wall**,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will **play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.**

### ***Growth & Ambition***

### ***Competitive Salary***

*But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…*

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, **each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply**

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**

That job description resonated with you?

title: Urban Resilience Expert
description:
Result of Service

The consultant contributes to the successful implementation and expansion of the City Resilience Global Programme by providing high-quality technical expertise, analytical support, capacity-building services, and programme development assistance to partner cities, territories, and institutions. The consultancy supports the achievement of UN-Habitat's objective of fostering inclusive, sustainable, climate-resilient, and risk-informed urban and territorial development by strengthening the capacity of public institutions, communities, and key stakeholders to understand risks, make informed decisions, mobilize resources, and implement integrated resilience and climate adaptation actions. The expected outcome is enhanced resilience capacity among local and regional governments, improved resilience planning and implementation, stronger multi-level governance mechanisms, increased access to financing opportunities, and the development of actionable strategies that contribute to the objectives of the New Urban Agenda, the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change, and the Sustainable Development Goals.

Work Location

Homebase

Expected duration

6 months

Duties and Responsibilities

The United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is the United Nations agency mandated by the General Assembly to promote socially, economically, and environmentally sustainable towns and cities. UN-Habitat works with national and local governments, civil society, academia, development partners, and the private sector to advance sustainable urbanization and improve the quality of life in human settlements worldwide. As the lead UN agency for sustainable urban development and human settlements, UN-Habitat plays a key role in supporting countries and local authorities to address increasing urban challenges, including climate change, disaster risk, environmental degradation, rapid urbanization, inequality, and vulnerability to shocks and stresses. Through its urban resilience programming, UN-Habitat promotes integrated, people-centered, and systems-based approaches that strengthen the capacity of cities and territories to anticipate, absorb, adapt, and transform in the face of current and future challenges. UN-Habitat's resilience work builds on global frameworks including the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, the New Urban Agenda, the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030, and the Paris Agreement on Climate Change, supporting local and regional governments in translating these commitments into effective action at territorial level. Recognizing that resilience challenges extend beyond administrative boundaries, UN-Habitat supports multi-level governance approaches that strengthen coordination among cities, metropolitan areas, regions, and national institutions. Its resilience interventions combine risk-informed planning, climate adaptation, disaster risk reduction, urban regeneration, nature-based solutions, governance strengthening, and inclusive stakeholder engagement to support sustainable territorial development. The programme works closely with local and regional governments, public institutions, civil society organizations, community groups, academia, and development partners to design and implement resilience-building initiatives. Attention is given to vulnerable populations, including women, youth, older persons, displaced populations, and other groups disproportionately affected by climate change, disasters, and socio-economic shocks. Main Responsibilities of the Urban Resilience Consultant: Under the direct supervision of the Head of the City Resilience Global Programme (CRGP), the consultant will provide technical support to the Programme and undertake the following tasks: Task 1. Implement the CRGP methodology and support technical operations with partner institutions, cities, and regions in collaboration with technical experts and focal points: - Review, reshape, and calibrate the methodology and analytical framework to the context of each city or territory. - Develop work plans and implementation strategy of the methodology with the partner local and regional governments. - Collaborate in the preparation of reports, including desk research, data analysis, writing, preparation of maps and diagrams, and report editing. - Facilitate stakeholder mapping and engagement processes to ensure inclusive participation of government entities, academia, civil society, and relevant technical partners. - Coordinate data collection, validation, and quality assurance processes with partner institutions. - Monitor implementation progress and identify operational risks and mitigation measures. Task 2. Provide knowledge generation, capacity building and technical expertise on urban resilience, disaster risk reduction, and climate adaptation: - Hold technical consultations, knowledge exchange and training sessions on urban resilience, territorial diagnostics and participatory planning. - Support and collaborate with project focal points and working groups/teams in the production of reports and planning of local activities. - Participate in institutional and policy dialogue sessions and support the development of relevant knowledge products. - Develop and deliver training materials, toolkits, and practical guidance documents for local stakeholders. - Capture and document lessons learned, good practices, and innovations emerging from project implementation. - Provide technical advisory support on integrating resilience, climate adaptation, and risk reduction considerations into local planning instruments. Task 3. Development of a cross-country comparative framework for NewMed 2030 project: - Develop the guiding steps for the analytical process to be utilized for producing city profiles under the NewMed 2030 framework. - Define the resilience targets and map out the indicators that will guide the analysis phase during the diagnosis. - Coordinate with CRPiT technical developer to align selected indicators and profile outputs. - Validate and document the incorporation of the framework with partner organizations. - Develop a comparative analytical methodology to assess resilience performance and trends across participating cities. - Establish indicators and criteria for benchmarking and cross-country learning. - Contribute to the design of data management and visualization approaches to support comparative analysis. Task 4. Development and dissemination of knowledge products: methodological guides, practical tools, and comparative reports for NewMed 2030 project: - Consolidate learnings from the project into a binational learning report. - Systematization of experiences and methodological guide. - Contribution to the refinement and monitoring of the NewMed2030 (phase 1) - Prepare technical briefs, policy notes, and dissemination materials targeting different stakeholder audiences. - Support the organization of knowledge-sharing events, webinars, and peer-learning exchanges. - Contribute to communication products highlighting project results, impacts, and lessons learned. - Develop comparative synthesis reports identifying regional trends, common challenges, and transferable practices. Task 5. Development of a Barcelona Resilience Profile and Recommended Actions for Resilience: - Development of roadmap and implementation strategy (including baseline data mapping and data collection strategy). - Full process implementation of the CRGP methodology with the Barcelona City Council. - Conduct technical workshops with stakeholders ensuring the engagement of relevant municipal representatives. - Development of interim reports, Resilience Profile, and Recommended Actions for Resilience and Sustainability (RAR-S) report. - Coordinate data collection and stakeholder validation processes required for profile development. - Support the prioritization and validation of resilience actions through participatory workshops. - Develop monitoring recommendations and implementation pathways for shortlisted resilience actions. - Facilitate alignment of proposed actions with existing municipal strategies and sectoral plans. Task 6: Support the head of the programme in proposal development, project formulation, and fundraising: - Contribute to the identification of funding opportunities and strategic partnerships. - Support the preparation of concept notes, project proposals, logical frameworks, workplans, and budgets. - Conduct background research and institutional mapping to support project formulation. - Contribute to donor reporting, project monitoring frameworks, and results-based management processes. - Support engagement with development partners, financing institutions, and regional networks. The expected results are: - Increased commitments to build local and regional level resilience. - Local and Regional Resilience assessments are conducted. - Key issues and challenges identified in linking early interventions in crisis-prone cities and regions to long-term sustainable development inputs. - Capacity is built in cities, territories, local and regional governments to develop and implement integrated local climate and disaster resilience action plans. - Crisis-prone cities and territories have enhanced capacity to develop and implement plans to increase their resiliency.

Qualifications/special skills

- An advanced university degree or equivalent professional qualification in urban and regional planning, urban studies, urban geography, architecture, or a related field is required. - A first-level university degree in one of the above fields, combined with two additional years of qualifying professional experience, may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree. A minimum of four (4) years of experience is required in developing resilience strategies, guidelines, toolkits or policies for effective urban environments, in liaising with private and governmental authorities, other national/international institutions and NGOs, and in working within diverse urban environments. Previous experience in projects related to urban planning, resilience, climate risk, disaster risk, or territorial analysis is required. Ability to work with minimal supervision and with good sense of initiative to keep the head of the programme regularly informed of progress is required. Good communications, reporting and representation skills are required for the position. Experience in the Mediterranean or MENA region, particularly Lebanon or Morocco, is an asset. Experience in Spain, particularly Catalunya, and Latin American countries is an asset. Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and other software packages required. Familiar with and committed to the goals of International Organization is desirable. Ability to work with minimal supervision and with good sense of initiative to keep the supervisor regularly informed of progress is required. Good teamwork and drive for results is desirable. Adaptable to rapidly changing priorities and able to manage multiple deadlines and deliver high quality work products. Able to meet deadlines for reporting and all project work is desirable Express enthusiasm and willingness to continue learning new skills and share experiences with other members of the team is desirable Willing to take responsibility, act professionally at all times, and make sure tasks are fully completed is desirable

Languages

- Fluency in spoken and written English is required. - Knowledge of other UN languages would be an additional asset. - Knowledge of Arabic and/or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Not available.

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

**Your role will be:**

* Supplier onboarding
* Conducting on-site social compliance audits of suppliers and manufacturing partners
* Assessing supplier compliance with the LVMH Code of Conduct
* Identifying potential risks within the supply chain and documenting irregularities
* Analyzing risk patterns and trends across the supply chain
* Developing and implementing Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs in collaboration with other departments

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience as a Social Auditor in an international audit firm
* Certification: certified by recognized auditing bodies (e.g.: SA8000, SMETA, APSCA)
* Knowledge of labor legislation and human rights regulations
* Ethical judgment, risk assessment, data verification, and compliance evaluation across social, environmental, and governance areas
* C1 level of English and Spanish
* Willingness to travel

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.

And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Global Social Media Specialist
description:
### **Position**

The Global Social Media Specialist reports directly to the Head of Global Media and Social Media, collaborating closer with other functions and departments including global and local Marketing teams.

**Your Mission:**

To manage and execute LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social media presence, ensuring a consistent, distinctive and engaging brand expression across international markets and platforms.

The role combines global social media management, editorial calendar ownership, creative content ideation, trend analysis and global coordination.

The Global Social Media Specialist will play a key role in identifying social media trends, defining content opportunities and translating platform insights into clear, actionable creative briefs for the Creative and Content teams.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of social media culture with a refined aesthetic sensibility, ensuring that LOEWE Perfumes’ unique creative universe is translated into relevant, innovative and platform-specific storytelling while preserving the brand’s luxury positioning.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Global Social Media Management & Editorial Planning**

* Manage day-to-day execution of LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social channels, ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, tone of voice and content quality.
* Own the global editorial calendar, aligning brand priorities, launches, campaigns, cultural moments and key marketing initiatives.
* Oversee end-to-end content planning: identify needs, define Creative briefs, coordinate asset delivery with internal stakeholders, schedule, publish and track performance.
* Translate global campaign storytelling into platform-specific content to maximize relevance and engagement.
* Evolve the brand’s organic presence through new formats, creative approaches, and platform developments.
* Monitor audience conversations, emerging trends and community sentiment, identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement and stronger brand affinity.
* Gather community insights to inform content planning and creative recommendations.

**Creative Content Ideation**

* Identify emerging trends, cultural conversations, formats, and content opportunities relevant to LOEWE Perfumes.
* Develop original, innovative, social-first ideas that translate the brand universe into engaging, platform-specific storytelling, including content beyond global campaign assets.
* Define creative and actionable briefs for Creative and Content teams, covering objectives, key messages, storytelling, formats and platform requirements.
* Partner with these teams throughout development to optimize creative execution for each platform.
* Contribute a social media perspective to brainstorming, campaign planning and content reviews; continuously evolve the content approach through creativity, cultural awareness and performance insights.

**Global & Regional Social Media Coordination**

* Act as a key contact between HQ and regional teams, aligning organic social media planning, content and define guidelines.
* Coordinate global calendars and content deployment across markets, including Asian channels (WeChat, RED, Weibo, Douyin, LINE, KakaoTalk)
* Support reviews of regional calendars, creative proposals and local adaptations, ensuring alignment with global strategy and approval processes.

* Monitor international social media developments, particularly in Asia, to identify trends, best practices and brand opportunities.
* Contribute to global social media guidelines and content frameworks.

* Analyze organic performance across global platforms, including reach, engagement, audience growth, video views and content effectiveness.
* Produce regular reports with actionable insights to improve content and channel performance.
* Benchmark competitors and track developments across luxury, beauty and digital culture, translating findings and performance insights into creative recommendations and content opportunities.
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic content amplification opportunities and align paid and organic initiatives.
* Support testing of new formats, creative approaches, and platform features.

### **Profile**

**Hard Skills**

* Proven experience managing organic social media channels for international or global brands, including content planning, editorial calendar management and publishing.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Instagram and TikTok, including platform-specific content formats, best practices and audience behavior.
* Previous experience or demonstrated working knowledge of Asian social media platforms, particularly WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), Weibo, Douyin, LINE and/or KakaoTalk.
* Experience coordinating content calendars, campaigns and social media activities across multiple markets or regional teams.
* Strong ability to identify social media trends and translate them into relevant content concepts, creative directions and actionable briefs.
* Proven experience collaborating with Creative and Content teams on content ideation, briefing, development and execution.
* Strong understanding of social-first storytelling, short-form video formats and platform-specific creative best practices.
* Ability to assess creative content from both a brand positioning and social media performance perspective.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, listening and analytics tools.
* Strong understanding of organic social media KPIs and performance reporting.
* Awareness of digital culture, emerging social media trends and luxury industry best practices.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong creative instinct and refined aesthetic sensibility, with a deep understanding of luxury brand codes.
* Ability to translate social media insights into relevant creative opportunities.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple content streams, deadlines and stakeholders.
* Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, particularly in multicultural and international environments.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Curious, culturally aware and passionate about social media, luxury, beauty and digital storytelling.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Approachable, inclusive and collaborative.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communication, Digital Media or similar
* 2–4 years of experience in social media, digital marketing
* Demonstrated experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating social media content across multiple markets.
* Previous experience developing content concepts and creative briefs in collaboration with Creative and Content teams.
* Experience or strong familiarity with Asian social media ecosystems, with an understanding of how content strategies and platform dynamics differ from Western markets.
* Experience in luxury, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
* Proven examples of social media projects demonstrating editorial planning, creative ideation and collaboration with creative teams.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is highly valuable; additional languages, particularly Asian languages, are a plus.

*LOEWE Perfumes represents the organic part of LOEWE. We are the unique Maison that crafts* *collectable botanical art pieces* *connected with nature in its purest form.*

*LOEWE Perfumes respects diversity and promotes inclusion from its recruitment process. We are committed to create an integrative working environment where all talents and singularities are engaged and valued.*

***LOEWE PERFUMES*** 
**MAISON**
--------------------------------

LOEWE Perfumes adds a multisensory dimension to LOEWE via a kaleidoscopic range of iconic fragrances for men, for women and for the home that combine vibrant, nature-inspired olfactory experiences with bold visual expression.

title: Senior Environment Surfacing Artist
description:
Skydance offers a dynamic, inclusive, and ever-evolving culture where innovative ideas are welcomed, and growth fostered. -

* Creates and develops stylized and realistic textures using photographic references, hand-painted techniques, procedural workflows, and existing texture assets, adapting approaches to different artistic styles and production requirements.
* Researches visual references and develops surfacing solutions independently when concept art or direct visual guidance is unavailable.
* Translates the Production Designer’s vision into cohesive surfacing solutions that support the overall visual language of the film.
* Ensures surfacing quality, consistency, and adherence to the established visual direction across assets, environments, and sequences.
* Creates, refines, and maintains materials using standard and procedural shading workflows, balancing artistic requirements with appropriate physical properties and visual style.
* Troubleshoots technical issues, tracks progress, and follows through to resolution.
* Takes ownership of assigned assets, ensuring quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborates with Supervisors, Leads, and upstream/downstream departments, including Modeling, Set Dressing, Rigging, Lighting, FX, and Compositing.
* Shares knowledge and supports the growth of less experienced artists.
* Proposes solutions to artistic and technical challenges, defining the best ways to proceed.
* Demonstrates strong organizational skills, including task prioritization and effective time management across multiple assignments.
* Maintains clear, proactive, and transparent communication.

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in the VFX or animation industry.
* 3+ years in the animation industry is desirable.
* Strong artistic sensibility and/or technical expertise related to 3D animation and VFX are required.
* Experience in Renderman and/or Arnold.
* Experience with Substance 3D Painter, Substance 3D Designer, and/or Mari.
* Strong knowledge of UV creation and layout.
* Understanding of related departments' workflows, including Modeling, Set Dressing, Lighting, FX, and Compositing.
* Experience optimizing complex scenes and rendering workflows.
* Experience managing large scenes, complex environments, and demanding sequences.
* Knowledge of Houdini, Solaris or Katana is desirable.
* USD and/or OSL knowledge is a plus.
* Knowledge of vegetation workflows (instances and scatters) is a plus.
* Understanding of displacement workflows (maps and geometry output).
* High English level desirable.

#Animation #LI-Hybrid

Skydance is a diversified media company founded by David Ellison in 2010 to create high quality, event-level entertainment for global audiences. The Company brings to life stories of immersive worlds across its feature film, television, interactive, and animation divisions.

Provide specialized support and operational coordination to the Senior Director Brand Activation and the Brand team, ensuring efficient and accurate execution aligned with business priorities.

Independently manage the Senior Director’s calendar, travel arrangements, and key administrative processes, anticipating needs, resolving issues, and ensuring appropriate follow-up on commitments.

Act as the point of contact for Travel & Expenses (T&E) policies and Concur across Iberia, promoting proper application and continuous process improvement.

Coordinate departmental information, vendors, and tools to facilitate decision-making and ensure a consistent experience for internal and external stakeholders.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Coordination and Support to the Senior Director Brand Activation and Brand Team**

* Proactively manage the Senior Director’s calendar, prioritizing meetings, identifying scheduling conflicts, and coordinating changes with internal and external stakeholders.
* Plan and organize meetings, prepare agendas and supporting documentation, take minutes, and follow up on agreements, owners, and target dates.
* Prepare and consolidate presentations, reports, and internal communications, ensuring quality, consistency, and confidentiality of information.
* Support the Brand leadership team with operational needs, meetings, visits, and cross-functional projects, acting as a coordination point when required.
* Act as the main point of contact and liaison with vendors, advertising agencies, event agencies, and other external partners, coordinating deliverables, documentation, and operational follow-up.
* Support the planning and execution of events, team meetings, international visits, and activations, coordinating schedules, logistics, materials, and vendors.
* Manage OTs, POs, and departmental invoices in SAP, following up on approvals and payments, identifying deviations, and escalating issues in a timely manner.
* Maintain up-to-date oversight of the department’s operational expenditure and prepare regular reports on invoicing, purchase orders, travel expenditure, and budget commitments to support decision-making.
* Coordinate and follow up on transportation invoices, shipments, deliveries, and material orders, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Create, structure, and maintain the department’s SharePoint, establishing filing, version control, and access criteria to ensure documentation remains up to date and easily accessible.
* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize administrative and operational processes, proposing and implementing practical solutions.
* Manage material orders and other operational requirements for the department, optimizing resources and anticipating future needs.

#### **Travel Organization and Management for the Brand Activation Department and Senior Director Brand Activation**

* Plan and coordinate individual and group travel, including bookings, itineraries, documentation, changes, and issue resolution, in accordance with corporate policies.
* Manage and review the Senior Director’s expense reports, ensuring accuracy, appropriate supporting documentation, approval, and timely submission.
* Support the Brand leadership team with travel arrangements, coordinating alternatives and resolving travel-related issues.
* Coordinate with Sales and other functions on the logistics of international visits, including agendas, transportation, accommodation, meeting rooms, and materials.
* Monitor travel expenditure, identify optimization opportunities, and prepare regular reporting on travel volume, costs, and policy compliance.

#### **Concur Iberia SPOC**

* Act as the functional point of contact for queries related to Concur and T&E policies across Iberia, providing guidance to employees and managers.
* Coordinate with Finance, Concur Global, and other teams to resolve issues, follow up on cases, and communicate relevant changes.
* Prepare guidelines, communications, and information sessions to promote the correct use of the tool and compliance with applicable policies.
* Analyze recurring queries and issues, identify root causes, and recommend process improvements or preventive actions.

### **KPIs**

* Satisfaction and quality of service provided to internal and external stakeholders.
* Timely delivery and quality in the management of calendars, meetings, travel, events, and visits.
* Accuracy, traceability, and processing time for OTs, POs, invoices, and expense reports.
* Quality of follow-up on invoices, shipments, deliveries, and operational issues, including timely escalation when required.
* Optimization of travel expenditure and level of compliance with T&E and Concur policies.
* Quality, accuracy, accessibility, and maintenance of the department’s SharePoint and documentation.
* Implementation of improvements that simplify processes, reduce issues, and increase operational efficiency.

### **Key Stakeholders**

* **Internal:** Senior Director Brand Activation, Brand leadership team and wider Brand team, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Internal Communications, IT, and Concur Global.
* **External:** Vendors, advertising and event agencies, media partners, travel agencies, transportation providers, and other authorized external partners.

### **Skills Profile**

* Excellent communication, coordination, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* Strong negotiation skills and professional vendor management capabilities.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, judgment, and accountability.
* Proactive and autonomous approach, with the ability to anticipate needs and make decisions within the scope of responsibility.
* Excellent organizational, planning, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
* Strong attention to detail, service orientation, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to turn operational data into meaningful insights to support decision-making.
* Continuous improvement mindset and ability to design simple, clear, and scalable processes.
* Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration skills within an international and dynamic environment.
* Understanding of the communications, marketing, and brand activation environment.

#### **IT Skills**

* Microsoft Office: advanced level, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
* Power BI: ability to prepare and maintain operational reports.
* SAP / S4: advanced user level for the management and tracking of OTs, POs, and invoices.
* SharePoint and collaboration tools: advanced level.
* Concur: advanced functional knowledge.
* **Languages:** Advanced English and fluent Spanish.

### **Education and Experience Requirements**

* University degree, preferably in Executive Assistance, Business Administration and Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Additional training in Marketing, Sales, Project Management, Events, or Travel & Expense management tools would be an advantage.
* Minimum of **2 years of professional experience** in coordination, executive assistance, or specialized support roles, preferably within a multinational company.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, vendors, invoices, and administrative processes with a high degree of autonomy.
* Previous experience within Brand, Marketing, Sales, or Communications teams and in international environments would be an advantage.

title: ​​Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Officer (Identity and Access Management) ​(P)
description:
**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy.

For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position.

**Organizational Context and Scope**

The ICT Officer Identity and Access Management will lead own and evolve the identity and access management (IDAM) ecosystem. The role will be the gatekeeper for the digital identity landscape, ensuring the right people (and devices) get the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons.

The role will be responsible for the design, implementation, and support of the identity orchestration using One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM), integrated with Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID), and HR-driven lifecycle events via the Oracle ERP (WAVE).

The ICT Officer (Identity and Access Management) must understand the art and science of automating access, enforcing least privilege, and reducing identity-related risks.
  
Under the leadership of the Director of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) / Chief Information Officer and reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, the ICT Officer Identity and Access Management (IDAM) is responsible for the identity and access management function within ICT.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES  
IDENTITY AND ACCESS MANAGEMENT**

* Design, configure, and maintain One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM) for user lifecycle management, provisioning, and role-based access control.
* Integrate identity data from the WAVE ERP system to drive Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes.
* Manage synchronization and identity federation between Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory (Entra ID).
* Define and implement access governance, including role modelling, segregation of duties (SoD), and access review campaigns.
* Develop automated workflows for account provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management across all ICT platforms.
* Collaborate with HR, Information Security, and Compliance teams to enforce identity related policies.
* Enforce Just-In-Time (JIT) access for sensitive operations.
* Monitor and respond to identity-related incidents and service requests.
* Create and maintain IAM documentation including architecture diagrams, SOPs, and audit records.
* Supervise the IAM team and conduct effective performance management and promote a cooperative work environment.

**MICROSOFT ACTIVE DIRECTORY AND ENTRA ID**

* Ensure correct operation of hybrid identity sync from AD to Entra ID via Azure AD Connect and monitor sync health and conflict resolution.
* Define entitlement management with access packages for joiners/movers/leavers.
* Enforce naming conventions and OU placement standards.
* Manage service accounts with lifecycle governance (preferably with expiration controls).
* Manage access using Azure AD roles, administrative units, and custom roles.
* Assign privileged roles via Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with time-bound or approval-based access.
* Define Conditional Access Policies based on risk, device, location, and user sensitivity.
* Enforce MFA using built-in Entra policies.
* Enable the publishing and management of SaaS apps using SAML, OAuth, or OIDC for Single Sign-On (SSO).
* Configure provisioning connectors to automate account creation in cloud apps.
* Build processes to enforce user consent restrictions to limit data exposure to risky apps.
* Create and maintain procedures for maintenance of security groups and distribution lists.
* Implement and enforce role-based access control (RBAC) through group nesting and inheritance.
* Periodically review and clean up stale groups and memberships and establish access review campaigns for groups, apps, and privileged roles across regional offices.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide input for the license entitlements and ensure correct integration with FinOps and licensing portals.
* Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS  
Education**

* Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,
* University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.
* The following certifications are required.
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
* Must attain and maintain ITIL version 4 Foundation certification and CISSP.
* One Identity - Identity Manager Foundations (#IM-FND) certification is an advantage.
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) is an added advantage.

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database .

**Experience**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in Identity & Access Management, IT Security, or related infrastructure engineering roles.
* Hands-on experience with One Identity - Identity Manager (strongly preferred).
* Solid proficiency in Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, and Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID).
* Experience in integrating IAM solutions with ERP systems for automated provisioning (e.g. SAP, Oracle).
* Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).
* Experience implementing RBAC, ABAC, and SoD controls.
* Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, SQL, or similar) for automating IAM workflows.

**Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to supervise and train teams to work effectively and harmoniously.
* Project management skills for efficient roll-out of ICT initiatives.
* Demonstrated understanding of automation of user lifecycle processes across HR, AD, and Entra ID.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate with business leaders and those with limited technical background effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential data in a professional, responsible and mature manner.
* Familiarity with global IT security trends and the ability to adapt NIST standards to evolving security threats and technologies.
* Working knowledge of supporting One Identity Manager, Active Directory and Entra ID.

**Languages**

For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).

Working knowledge of an official UN Language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

**Required Competencies**

Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

**Values** - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

* Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
* Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
* Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
* Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
* Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

**Core Competencies** – behavioural indicators

* Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
* Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
* Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
* Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization's priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
* Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

**Managerial Competencies** – behavioural indicators

* Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization's vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
* Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
* Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
* Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization's goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.  

**Notes**

Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security as well as accreditation, any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.

IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.

IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Head of Customer Service (all genders)
description:
Málaga, Spain

Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

**Your future team**

As Head of Customer Service, you'll lead Holidu's Customer Happiness front line from our Málaga office: 3 in-house Team Leads, almost 40 in-house advisors, and 150+ partner advisors. You may initially lead one market team directly while we complete the Team Lead bench.

You'll report to the Director of Customer Happiness and work alongside our enablement teams whose job is to equip the front line to succeed. We're at a turning point: we're moving to a new case management platform, rethinking how we measure performance, and redesigning how our teams work together. You'll be one of the people shaping it.

**What you will do**

**Own front-line performance**

* Own the results of our internal and external handling teams: resolution, customer satisfaction, response and resolution times, and productivity
* Set clear expectations, run a weekly performance rhythm with your Team Leads and partners, and act fast when results slip
* Make the tough calls when needed - on performance, staffing and priorities

**Lead the leaders**

* Manage, coach and develop our Team Leads in Málaga, building a leadership team that sets a high standard and holds each other accountable
* Potentially lead one market team directly at first, and stay close to the work by regularly handling cases yourself
* Build a culture of ownership, independent judgement, and pride in the work, with a clear development path for advisors from junior to senior

**Get the best out of our partners**

* Share accountability with our Workforce Management team for partner performance: help define performance targets, train and coach partner teams on their floors, and funnel partner feedback to our enablement teams so root causes get fixed
* Spend time on site with them, review quality together, and reduce escalations that bounce back to the in-house team
* Contribute to partner selection, onboarding and incentive design

**Fix how we work**

* Spot and remove friction on the front line: unnecessary escalations, duplicated work and outdated processes
* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

**Life at Holidu**

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram@lifeatholidu

ZEST Hotel Resort is where dynamic energy meets effortless luxury. Designed for those who seek both indulgence and authenticity, we create a space where creativity thrives and every moment is a celebration of the senses. From vibrant days by the pool to elegant evenings under the stars, ZEST pulses with movement, music, and connection. Our approach to luxury is relaxed yet refined, stylish, welcoming, and always inspiring. Here, pleasure is an art, and every stay is an unforgettable experience.

ZEST Hotel Resort is a new luxury resort in Cap Negret, Ibiza, scheduled to open in April 2027. With 206 rooms and seven villas, destination dining, wellness facilities, and a Beach Club, we are building a team that will bring warm, thoughtful hospitality to every part of the guest experience.

  

**About the Role**

Lead the Rooms Division behind one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury resort openings. Inspired by The ZEST Effect and our commitment to personalised hospitality, we are looking for an exceptional **Director of Rooms** to join our Executive Leadership Team and shape every aspect of the guest journey.

Reporting directly to the Hotel Manager, the Director of Rooms will oversee Front Office, Concierge, Bell Door Services, Guest Experience, Telephone Operations, Housekeeping and Laundry, ensuring a seamless and elevated experience from pre-arrival through to post-departure.

This is a unique opportunity to create and launch a world-class Rooms operation from the ground up. You will play a key role in defining service standards, building high-performing teams, delivering exceptional guest satisfaction, and positioning ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza as one of the island's most sought-after luxury lifestyle destinations.

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence, guest loyalty, financial performance, team engagement, and service innovation whilst bringing the ZEST culture and values to life across every guest interaction.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the overall Rooms Division strategy, ensuring alignment with the resort's vision, luxury positioning, and business objectives.

* Drive exceptional guest satisfaction by delivering highly personalized experiences, managing VIP stays, resolving complex guest concerns, and continuously improving service quality.

* Recruit, develop, coach, and inspire a high-performing Rooms leadership team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Manage departmental budgets, payroll, productivity, and operating costs while maximizing efficiency without compromising the guest experience.
* Partner closely with Revenue Management, Reservations, Engineering, and other operational departments to optimize room inventory, upgrades, upselling opportunities, and overall operational performance.
* Monitor guest feedback, quality audits, and market trends to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation.
* Ensure compliance with luxury hospitality standards, health safety requirements, data protection regulations, and sustainability initiatives across the division.
* Champion the ZEST culture and service philosophy, bringing Freedom, Connection, Pleasure, and Exploration to life for both guests and employees.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Degree in Hospitality Management, Tourism, Business Administration or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant luxury hospitality leadership experience within Rooms Division operations.
* Proven success leading both Front Office and Housekeeping functions.
* Experience managing villa operations and highly personalised guest experiences.
* Strong background in luxury resort environments, lifestyle hospitality brands or complex multi-outlet properties.
* Previous pre-opening experience is highly desirable.
* Experience developing service standards, procedures and high-performing teams.
* Strong financial, budgeting and workforce planning capabilities.
* Proficiency with PMS platforms, reputation management systems and operational reporting tools.
* Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English and Spanish.
* Valid EU work authorisation or the appropriate Spanish work permit.

Key Competencies

* Inspirational and people-focused leadership.
* Emotional intelligence and empathy.
* Luxury guest experience expertise.
* Strong operational judgement and decision-making.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Anticipation and proactive problem-solving.
* Commercial and financial acumen.
* Cross-cultural communication skills.
* Discretion and integrity.
* Ability to execute and deliver results.
* Alignment with ZEST values, culture and service philosophy.

  

**Benefits**

At ZEST, we believe every memorable stay begins with exceptional hospitality delivered through meaningful human connections. As Director of Rooms, you will have the opportunity to design the guest experience, service culture and operational standards that define the ZEST brand

* Competitive executive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to join the Executive Leadership Team of a flagship luxury resort.
* Be part of a pre-opening team and influence key strategic decisions from day one.
* Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career development.
* Exposure to a dynamic luxury hospitality environment with significant growth potential.
* Employee recognition and engagement initiatives that celebrate success and performance.
* The opportunity to make a lasting impact on a landmark hospitality destination.

  

**Why Join ZEST?**

This is far more than a traditional Rooms leadership role. You will join the Executive Team responsible for launching one of Ibiza's most exciting new luxury lifestyle resorts, helping shape its guest experience, operational excellence, reputation and commercial success from day one.

If you are looking for an opportunity to leave your mark on a landmark hospitality project and create a luxury guest experience that becomes synonymous with excellence in Ibiza, we would love to hear from you.

**ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.**

title: Biology Lab Research Support Technician
description:
ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences is a world-leading research center devoted to advancing the science and technologies of light. Based in Castelldefels, Barcelona, ICFO combines frontier research, education, innovation and technology transfer to generate scientific and societal impact.

Over the past two decades, ICFO has established itself as an internationally recognized center of excellence and a global reference in photonics. Today, with a highly international community of around 500 employees representing more than 70 nationalities, ICFO continues its institutional development aimed at strengthening scientific excellence, organizational effectiveness and long-term impact.

As a public research institution, ICFO is governed by a Board of Trustees and led by an Executive Leadership comprising the Director and the Managing Director, who are responsible for the scientific, strategic and operational development of the Institute.

ICFO is seeking a **Biology Lab Research Support Technician** to join its Biology Lab.

**Position Overview**

The main responsibilities of the Biology Lab Technician will have two components:

* operation and organization of the Laboratories and common areas of the Unit, and
* provide support to the research activity of Lab users.

**Key Responsibilities**

The main responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to) the following:

1. Supporting tasks in the management of the Facility:

* Assist in the registration, control and maintenance of the inventory of biological samples (mammalian cells, microorganisms, worms, model organisms, antibodies, etc.) of the Unit.
* Assist in the purchasing process, registration, supervision and maintenance of the inventory of laboratory consumables, media, reagents and chemicals, safeguarding their correct handling and storage.
* Organization and service of laboratory equipment as well as the glassware and plastic items.
* Handling and management of the biological and chemical waste generated in the Unit.
* Assist with the permanent training activities to Biology Lab users regarding safety and biosafety regulations.
* Assist with the permanent training activities regarding the use of equipment, handling of biological samples and chemicals,
* Development, implementation and vigilance of routine protocols oriented to ensuring the correct handling and disposal of biological and chemical waste generated in the Lab.

  
2.- Research support responsibilities:
  

* Perform routine culture and maintenance of mammalian cell lines, microorganisms and other model organisms.
* Perform routine breeding tasks and basic research procedures involving living animals.
* Assist in tasks related to the preparation and sterilization of culture media, buffers, reagents and additives.
* Perform routine protocols of classic and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques for cloning, extraction, purification and characterization of DNA and proteins.
* Preparation of samples for high-resolution microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Perform routine tasks related to the culture, handling and storage of C. elegans and other model organisms.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or similar).
* Updated official credential to work with experimental living animals (Projects and Procedures Design Function. RD 53/2013).
