title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

title: Technical Writer
description:

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.
* Build internal capability in advanced modelling techniques, external data utilisation, and pricing technology tools running knowledge-sharing sessions and supporting technical upskilling.
* Foster a high-performance pricing culture grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness, and a drive for continuous innovation.
* Identify and develop talent within the team; support succession planning aligned with Allianz Partners' people strategy and the RSA pricing function's long-term growth.

What you will bring
  
  
EXPERIENCE BACKGROUND
  
  

* 10+ years in pricing, actuarial, or underwriting roles with deep expertise in PC or assistance/travel insurance pricing.
* Minimum 3 years leading a pricing function, with direct management of international teams of 5+ FTEs.
* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, or comparable GLM/ML actuarial platforms.
* Demonstrated track record integrating external data sources and third-party platforms into pricing models in a production environment.
* Experience presenting pricing strategy and modelling outcomes to CRO, CFO, or Board-level stakeholders.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage given the global scope.

TECHNICAL MODELLING SKILLS
  
  

* Expert-level command of GLM-based rating engine development; proficiency in GBMs, Random Forests, and other ML techniques applied to insurance pricing.
* Hands-on with WTW Radar and/or Emblem for rate relativities, model fitting, and scenario testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for pricing analytics, model automation, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) and their application to insurance pricing pipelines.
* Experience with external data integration: geo-spatial data (e.g., Verisk, CoreLogic), medical cost databases, telematics feeds, open weather/climate APIs, and socio-demographic enrichment layers.
* Knowledge of pricing optimisation and elasticity modelling techniques, including demand modelling and customer lifetime value frameworks.
* Solid grounding in actuarial concepts: profit testing, reserving, reinsurance structures, and PL interpretation (GWP, NEP, loss ratio, CoR).

EDUCATION
  
  

* Degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Actuarial qualification or progress toward one (FIA, FCAS, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

title: Managing Tech Lead - Europa Universalis V
description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

**Practical information**
-------------------------

Scope: Full-time and permanent

Location: Sitges, Barcelona (Spain)

WFH/WFO: 100% onsite

Reports to: Head of Operations

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Head of Growth

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Base Salary:** $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

title: Executive Communications Lead
description:
**Why Mozilla?**

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

**About this team and role:**

The browser, and browser engine remain how we underpin choice and control when people access the web. Now, AI is posing generation-defining questions: what say do people have in their choices online and who controls the web? Over 25 years ago Mozilla and allies took on this challenge, but the time has come to revisit some fundamentals. This is exactly the kind of moment Firefox was built for.

We're looking for a Head of Executive Communications to lead how Mozilla's senior leaders show up in the world. This is a role for someone who has experience working directly with a CEO, thinks strategically, writes exceptionally well, has strong project management skills and understands how to translate complex ideas into narratives that move people and shape debates.

Mozilla has a perspective that is rare in tech. We are driven by our double bottom line, not by shareholders. We are a deeply technical organization, mission-driven, and have decades of experience at the heart of the open web. Getting that perspective heard, and heard in the right rooms, is what this role is about.

You will own executive visibility and thought leadership for Mozilla's CEO and leadership team, working closely with the wider Communications team, Product teams and Public Policy to ensure our leaders are positioned as authoritative, credible voices on the issues that define the future of the internet. You will report into the Director of Corporate Communications and serve as a trusted strategic partner to the executives you support.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the executive communications function: develop and drive a proactive, strategic approach to how Mozilla's CEO and senior leadership team are seen and heard externally.
* Prepare executives for high-stakes engagements: major interviews, keynotes, regulatory testimony, crisis moments, and industry forums.
* Build and manage an executive visibility calendar that is proactive, strategic, and aligned to Mozilla's goals, not just reactive to inbound requests.
* Write, develop, and refine speeches, keynote remarks, op-eds, briefing documents, talking points, and interview preparation materials across a range of formats and audiences.
* Build productive working relationships and act as a consistent partner to the executives you support: understanding their voice, their expertise, and how to marry both to Mozilla's corporate objectives.
* Partner closely with the broader Communications team, Public Policy, Marketing and other cross functional teams to ensure executive communications is consistent with and reinforcing Mozilla's broader narrative, policy positions, and product moments.
* Develop a thought leadership strategy that positions Mozilla's leadership as distinctive, credible voices on the questions that matter, but are often in a crowded space: AI and the future of the web, privacy and digital rights, open source, competition, and the intersection of technology and public interest.
* Coordinate with external agencies and freelance writers where needed, maintaining a high editorial bar throughout.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 8–12+ years of experience in communications, with a significant focus on executive communications, speechwriting, or thought leadership, ideally in or around technology, policy, or mission-driven organisations.
* Direct experience of working at CEO level, and the ability to work across teams and build trust with senior stakeholders quickly.
* Exceptional writing skills. You write clearly, quickly, and in other people's voices. Your op-eds are readable. Your briefing documents are used. Your talking points don't sound like talking points.
* A track record of preparing senior executives for high-stakes external engagements, and of making them better communicators over time.
* Strong editorial judgement for both the issues and the draft: you identify where Mozilla's leadership should participate in public debate, where they should shape it, and where they should stay out of it; you know what a good argument looks like, you know when a draft isn't there yet, and you can explain why.
* Experience working at the intersection of technology, policy, and public interest, or a clear understanding of why Mozilla's position in that space matters.
* Comfort with complexity and nuance. Mozilla operates at the intersection of technology, policy, and public interest, and our communications environment reflects that.
* Mission alignment. You understand why Mozilla exists, you find the work meaningful, and that comes through in how you operate.
* Commitment to our values:

* + Play to win
  + Build for people first
  + Engage evidence over ego
  + Decide and deliver
  + Ship, learn, repeat

**What will help you stand out:**

* Global or multilingual experience: coordinating people across regions or working with international press.
* Policy or public affairs exposure: a basic government affairs understanding of some of our key issues (privacy, security, AI, competition).

**What you’ll get:**

* Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
* Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

**About Mozilla**

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

Maintain strong relationships with reporters at the consumer outlets that matter, and manage our agency partner.

* **Cultural relevance.** Keep a finger on the pulse of what's happening in culture, and know how to put Headway into that conversation in a way that's true to the brand. Be comfortable taking smart risks to create a real buzz moment.

* You have 10+ years in consumer communications — ideally including at least 3+ years in-house leading teams. You’ve also led or partnered closely with social or content marketing.

* You have deep media relations skills, real relationships with reporters at relevant consumer outlets, and experience managing an agency.

* Bonus points if you've worked in mental health or another regulated industry.

This is a rare moment — Headway is at the inflection point where scale meets credibility, and the person who builds this function will leave a lasting mark on how behavioral health is delivered and funded in America. If that sounds like the challenge you've been waiting for, we'd love to meet you.

title: Community Manager
description:
Kickstarter is the leading crowdfunding platform for creative projects across film, games, music, art, design, and technology. Since our founding in 2009, our mission to help bring creative projects to life has been powered by the people behind the work.

Together, we’ve helped creators around the world launch creative projects that have generated billions of dollars in pledges. That same commitment extends inward. Rooted in shared values, Kickstarter invests in the growth and success of our team, treating employees as whole people and empowering them with the autonomy and space to participate in decisions that shape their work and our company.

Kickstarter is seeking an experienced Community Manager to join our Marketing team. This role sits at the heart of how Kickstarter shows up and is perceived across the places our community talks: social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the corners of the internet where creators and backers compare notes. Reporting to the Director, Brand and Communications, the Community Manager will listen, respond, and engage, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to route what they hear to the people who can act on it.

As the owner of Kickstarter’s community presence and reputation, they serve as our early-warning system when sentiment shifts or a problem starts to spread. This is not a “schedule posts and check metrics” role. The ideal candidate is already deep in these communities, knows the norms of each one, and gets a little twitchy when a thread starts to turn.

The salary for this role in the United States is $115,905.50.

#### **In This Role, You Will:**

*Reputation Management and Monitoring*

* Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and emerging narratives across social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the broader web, in real time.
* Spot early signals of reputational risk (a viral complaint, a controversial project, a misunderstanding of our policies), assess severity, and lead the response, partnering with Communications, Trust & Safety, Legal, and leadership on sensitive or high-stakes moments.
* Design and own the escalation framework with Communications, Trust & Safety, Support, Product, Legal, and leadership, including severity tiers, owners, and response timelines.
* Build, own, and continuously refine response playbooks for common scenarios (project controversies, creator disputes, outages, policy changes, and press-driven moments), and run post-incident reviews to improve them.
* Define how we measure community sentiment and reputation, and deliver regular reporting to senior stakeholders that connects trends to business and mission impact, with clear recommendations.

*Community Engagement*

* Show up as Kickstarter in public conversations, in a voice that is human, direct, and well-informed.
* Participate credibly in Reddit and Discord communities, following each community’s rules and culture rather than treating them as broadcast channels.
* Correct misinformation helpfully, de-escalate heated threads, and know when not to respond.
* Support creators and backers by pointing them to the right resources, and handing off to Support when an issue needs a ticket.
* Celebrate creator milestones and engage with backers and make Kickstarter feel present and human beyond our owned social channels.
* Set voice, tone, and engagement guidelines for Kickstarter’s presence in community spaces, and coach teammates who engage on the company’s behalf.

*Feedback Loop*

* Own a community feedback program that turns unstructured community input into prioritized, evidence-backed insights for Product, Design, Policy, Support, and Creator Success, and track what gets acted on.
* Maintain a living picture of the top recurring pain points, feature requests, and trust issues, with examples.
* Close the loop publicly when we ship something the community asked for.
* Build and run a creator and backer advocacy program, identifying enthusiastic community members for testimonials, campaigns, and storytelling.

*Programs and Operations*

* Own the strategy and operation of Kickstarter-owned community spaces (e.g., Discord, creator forums), including moderation guidelines, tooling, and volunteer or mod programs.
* Align Social, Comms, and our creator-facing teams on campaigns, launches, and announcements so community context is built in from the start.
* Select, manage, and optimize our social listening and community tooling, including vendor evaluation and measurement.
* Track emerging creator communities, cultural trends, competitor conversations, new platforms and community behaviors.
* Translate community insights into recommendations that inform marketing, acquisition, and product priorities.

#### **About You**

* You have 4+ years in community management, social media, reputation management, or a related role, ideally at a platform, marketplace, or consumer tech company.
* You have deep, demonstrable fluency in Reddit and Discord, as a longtime participant and not just a brand account. You know what a good community looks like and what gets a brand banned or mocked.
* You have hands-on experience across the major social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads), including how norms and audiences differ on each.
* You have experience monitoring and managing sentiment on review and feedback sites (e.g., Trustpilot, App Store and Google Play reviews, Hacker News, and niche forums).
* You have strong judgment under pressure and ambiguity: you can tell a vocal minority from a real problem and a mistake from a crisis, and you make clear recommendations or calls without waiting to be told what to do.
* You are an excellent writer. You can be warm, plain-spoken, and precise, and you can adapt tone to the platform and the moment.
* You have experience with social listening and community tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater, Mention, or similar).
* You have experience building processes and aligning cross-functional partners, and you communicate clearly and credibly with executives, Legal, and Trust & Safety when stakes are high.
* You have a track record of owning a community, reputation, or voice-of-customer program end to end, with measurable results.
* You are familiar with crowdfunding, creator economy, or maker communities (games, comics, film, music, design, publishing, tech).
* You are familiar with platform-specific communities like BoardGameGeek, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers, or creator-focused Discords.
* You have experience handling public-facing communications during controversies or policy changes.
* You have data skills: you are comfortable building dashboards or pulling insights from large volumes of unstructured text.

**Our Fully Virtual Team**

We’re currently able to support employees based in the following US locations: CA, CO, CT, GA, IL, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, OR, SC, VA, VT, and WA. We're also able to support employees in the United Kingdom. If you live in—or are willing to move to—any of these locations, we look forward to your application! If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description.

Kickstarter is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Reminder to applicants: Authentic communications from Kickstarter will always originate from official Kickstarter email domains (@kickstarter.com). Exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of anyone who claims to be representing Kickstarter on other platforms.

Please reach out to Kickstarter’s Help Center to report potentially fraudulent contact here: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

**About Care Access**

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.**

With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com.

### **How This Role Makes a Difference**

**This is a full-time, 6-month temporary position.**

If storytelling were in the Olympics, you'd be a gold medalist. You want to join a team that's not just about work; you want to make an impact and leave an amazing legacy behind. Your daily diet includes passion, self-motivation, proactiveness, creative thinking, flexibility, and juggling responsibilities, and you are not intimidated by new challenges. You're not looking for a job, you're looking for a playground for your brilliance in story telling via creative audio/video production.

You log in early morning while sipping coffee or tea and realize that there is a Care Access event taking place in Santa Claus, Indiana. You quickly, without hesitation, pitch several ideas to the team. Dept Manager messages the team: "Folks! We accidentally hired a genius!". Your other ideas are rejected with explained reasons which do not bother you at all. As you are busy coming up with a strategy and execution plan, another project pops up, "No worries" you tell yourself "I got this, I can manage multiple projects". As challenges and barriers face you, you know that you're not alone. You communicate with team members in removing those barriers.

The plot thickens; you must be in three places at the same time! You resolve that by vetting and finding resources. While that is taking shape, you realize that this is not about projects. This is about human lives and the future of medicine. Finally, you do not end up with completed projects; you end up being part of the ever-evolving story of the future of medicine.

* Concept Development & Scriptwriting: Expertly translate high-level creative concepts into actionable production blueprints, generating innovative story suggestions and writing finalized scripts from basic outlines.
* Pre-Production Strategy: Oversee all facets of the pre-production lifecycle, creating comprehensive shot lists, scheduling production timelines, and building visual storyboards to align the crew before filming.

* Post-Production Oversight: Partner collaboratively with video editors through the post-production pipeline, managing detailed revision loops and editorial reviews to ensure the final cut matches the pre-production vision.
* Domain Specialization: Possess a deep, end-to-end understanding of the entire video production lifecycle, with a strong preference for candidates who have experience producing content within the healthcare or clinical space.

title: Sourcing Manager - Remote
description:

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we've expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We've done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We're rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That's where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

  

**THE JOB**

At VEG, we find a way to say YES, including finding new ways to connect great people with meaningful careers.

As a Temporary Sourcing Manager, you'll help identify talent and build candidate pipelines through research, market mapping, and recruiting technology. Reporting to the Director of Talent Sourcing, you'll partner with our sourcing team to uncover prospective candidates, identify opportunities to reconnect with talent, and support recruiting campaigns across priority markets.

This is a three-month assignment for someone who enjoys hands-on sourcing work, takes pride in accuracy, and uses technology thoughtfully. You'll take ownership of research and sourcing projects that contribute directly to VEG's recruiting efforts.

* Research talent and map veterinary markets to identify prospective candidates for priority hiring needs.
* Build and maintain accurate candidate lists with relevant experience, location, and contact information.
* Review candidate activity in Greenhouse and Gem to identify previous interactions and opportunities for re-engagement.
* Verify candidate information, resolve duplicate records, and keep recruiting data organized and current.
* Use AI tools to support research, compare information, and improve efficiency while checking results for accuracy.
* Support sourcing campaigns, recruiting events, and re-engagement efforts through targeted research and candidate list preparation.
* Share relevant findings with sourcing partners, manage project deadlines, and identify ways to improve recurring processes.

  

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* Experience in talent sourcing or recruiting research, with demonstrated success identifying relevant talent and building candidate pipelines.
* Practical experience using AI tools for research or data-related tasks, including verifying results and recognizing when further review is needed.
* Strong research and organizational skills, with attention to detail when working with candidate information and spreadsheets.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruiting CRM platforms. Familiarity with Greenhouse and Gem is a plus.
* Clear communication and the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively.
* Availability for a three-month assignment. Veterinary or healthcare recruiting experience is helpful but not required.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Curious and resourceful. You enjoy researching, asking thoughtful questions, and finding information that helps others move forward.
* Detail-oriented. You take pride in accurate work and follow through on your commitments.
* Collaborative and service-minded. You understand your partners' needs and share information clearly.
* Accountable and proactive. You take ownership, communicate challenges early, and work toward solutions.
* Humble and open to feedback. You acknowledge mistakes, learn from others, and celebrate shared accomplishments.
* Thoughtful about technology. You look for practical ways to improve your work while applying your own judgment.

  

**HOW WE INVEST IN YOU**

* This is a 3 month salaried contract position.The bi-weekly salary range for this role is $3,200–$4,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and geographic location.
* The opportunity to contribute to hiring at a growing veterinary emergency company.
* Collaboration with experienced sourcing and Talent Acquisition professionals.
* Access to recruiting technology and opportunities to apply your research and AI skills.
* A mission-driven culture that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

  

**BETTER TOGETHER: WHY IN-PERSON MATTERS AT VEG HQ**

Our hospitals thrive on in-person collaboration, and VQ is no different. Time in the office sparks stronger connections, meaningful conversations, and better results—all bringing our core values to life. We prioritize being present because our values are best achieved side by side. Plus, we make getting here easy with free parking and a shuttle from the White Plains Metro-North station.

  

**DEI**

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is "Helping people and their pets when they need it most." And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world's veterinary emergency company.

title: Associate Director, Client Management (Influencer & Celebrity)
description:
Brilliant is seeking a full-time **Associate Director, Client Management** for our Influencer & Celebrity team. This role will own the day-to-day client relationship and keep every influencer program on time, on budget, and flawlessly executed.

**The Role**
------------

This is a client-facing, project-management-first role. All day, every day, you are the voice of Brilliant to our clients: you run the calls, write the recap, chase the approvals, and make sure nothing slips. Our strategy and talent leads build the programs; you make sure they get delivered.

You are hyper-organized. You know where every creator, contract, deliverable, and invoice stands at any moment. You understand influencer budgets inside and out, and you have done this in high-volume agency settings where dozens of creators and multiple brands are live at once.

**Who We Are**
--------------

We’re a fully remote performance team built on a simple promise: *Work Hard. Play Hard. Laugh Hard.*

We aren't for the faint of heart. We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. But we also believe that intense drive should come with great culture, which is why we offer unlimited PTO, Fabulous Fridays (doors close at 3pm), virtual happy hours, a monthly book club, and endless reasons to win together.

And the industry notices: we were recently named an **Inc. Best Workplace 2026** and landed on the **Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 2026.**

**What We Do**
--------------

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own the client relationship**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for multiple influencer and celebrity accounts across Zoom, email, and Slack.
* Lead weekly status calls and client meetings, and send same-day recaps with clear next steps, owners, and deadlines.
* Know your clients’ brands, products, retail calendars, and stakeholders cold, and build relationships they trust.
* Manage expectations proactively: flag risks early, present solutions, and keep clients informed before they have to ask.
* Pull together campaign data, content, and results for client reviews, QBRs, and milestone presentations.
* Listen critically in every meeting to spot incremental opportunities within existing accounts, and bring them to leadership.

### **Run the project, end to end**

* Own campaign timelines from kickoff through final reporting, so every program is delivered on time and aligned with client objectives.
* Build and maintain project management tools and trackers (AirTable, Asana, or similar) that give the team and clients a single source of truth.
* Track every moving piece: creator outreach, contracts, product shipments, content drafts, client approvals, go-live dates, and usage windows.
* Coordinate across Brilliant’s strategy, talent, paid media, PR, social, and analytics teams to keep integrated campaigns in sync.
* Ensure every program meets FTC disclosure guidelines and brand safety standards.
* Keep creator issues to a minimum, and handle the ones that arise calmly and quickly.

### **Manage the money**

* Own influencer budgets on assigned accounts: track talent spend, gifting, product costs, fees, and paid amplification against approved budgets.
* Build and maintain budget trackers and flag overages or underspend before they become problems.
* Lead monthly billing reconciliation with finance, making sure creator payments, invoices, and client billing match.
* Provide inputs on account profitability and scope, and raise when work is drifting out of scope.

### **Lead and develop the team**

* Oversee specialists and coordinators on campaign execution, and set the standard for client correspondence, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Mentor junior team members: what training do they need, and how can we encourage their growth?
* Help build and improve the client management processes, templates, and playbooks that let the team scale without sacrificing quality.

### **Stay sharp**

* Keep a pulse on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, and share trends with clients and the team.
* Bring energy to brainstorms and push the team to think bigger.

**Our Dream Team Member**
-------------------------

* 5–7 years of client service or account management experience, with at least 3 years in influencer marketing.
* Experience in a high-volume influencer agency setting, managing many creators and multiple brands at once. Large-agency experience strongly preferred.
* A deep understanding of influencer budgets: talent rates, fees, gifting, usage rights, whitelisting costs, and how they roll up to a client budget.
* Experience leading monthly billing reconciliation and tracking account profitability.
* Hyper-organized. You build the tracker, you live in the tracker, and you never miss a deadline.
* Fluency in project management tools such as AirTable or Asana, plus familiarity with CreatorIQ, HypeAuditor, Shopify Collabs, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of paid, gifted, affiliate, and ambassador programs, plus whitelisting, Spark Ads, and Partnership Ads.
* Experience overseeing or mentoring junior team members.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with composure and confidence on camera in client meetings.
* Can manage up, manage down, and keep a million moving pieces running smoothly.
* Resourceful, committed, deliberate, and genuinely enjoys crossing things off the list.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with parenting, baby, kids, toy, or family lifestyle brands.
* Experience with celebrity talent partnerships and working with agents, managers, and publicists.
* Experience on integrated campaigns that combine influencer with PR, experiential, or retail activations.
* A slight obsession with Amazon, online shopping, and discovering new products.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO
* Paid time off between Christmas and New Year's
* Fabulous Fridays: the work day ends at 3pm all year
* 401K with a 3% company match (immediately vested) after the initial 3 months
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Medical and Dependent Care FSA
* Company-paid Life Insurance
* Company-paid Long-Term Disability

**Salary Range:** 85K–95K

title: Head of Apparel Design & Product Development
description:
**Company:** Controlled Insanity  
**Position:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Product Development & Design

Controlled Insanity is a premium bodybuilding and streetwear brand focused on creating innovative, heavyweight apparel that challenges traditional gymwear. We pride ourselves on unique garment construction, distinctive silhouettes, premium materials, and designs that stand apart from the standard fitness apparel market.

We are looking for someone who shares this vision and can help push the boundaries of what our clothing can become.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative, experienced, and innovation-driven **Head of Apparel Design & Product Development** to lead the development of new clothing concepts, garment bases, silhouettes, and product innovations for Controlled Insanity.

This person will be responsible for continuously researching, conceptualizing, designing, and developing new apparel from the initial idea all the way through finalized, manufacturer-ready tech packs and production.

We are not simply looking for someone who can take an existing garment and make minor adjustments. We want someone who can independently come up with original garment concepts, identify opportunities in the market, experiment with new construction techniques, and develop completely new product bases that give Controlled Insanity a competitive advantage.

You will play a major role in shaping the future of our product catalog and establishing a recognizable design identity for the brand.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Design & Innovation**

* Continuously develop new and innovative clothing concepts and garment bases.
* Create original silhouettes, fits, cuts, paneling, seam placements, and construction techniques.
* Develop unique variations of existing product categories while introducing entirely new categories.
* Experiment with unconventional garment details, functional features, and design elements.
* Push beyond standard gymwear designs to create distinctive, recognizable products.

**2. Technical Design & Tech Packs**

* Create detailed, manufacturer-ready tech packs for every approved product.
* Produce technical flats, garment measurements, construction details, stitching specifications, and material requirements.
* Specify fabric compositions, GSM, trims, washes, hardware, and finishing details.
* Develop measurement charts, grading specifications, and sizing standards.
* Ensure all technical documentation is accurate and production-ready.

**3. Fabric & Material Research**

* Research and source innovative fabrics, textiles, and materials.
* Experiment with different fabric weights, textures, compositions, and treatments.
* Identify opportunities for unique washes, dyeing techniques, distressing, embroidery, printing, and garment finishing.
* Continuously research new manufacturing techniques and apparel innovations.

**4. Market Research & Competitive Analysis**

* Regularly analyze leading bodybuilding, streetwear, and athletic apparel brands.
* Identify emerging trends, product opportunities, and gaps in the market.
* Research successful garment constructions and identify ways to create original alternatives.
* Stay ahead of industry developments and continuously bring new ideas to the team.

**5. Product Development & Sampling**

* Communicate directly with manufacturers and suppliers regarding product development.
* Oversee sample creation and evaluate fit, construction, materials, and overall quality.
* Provide detailed revisions and corrections to manufacturers.
* Manage products through multiple sampling stages until final approval.
* Ensure the finished garment matches the original creative and technical vision.

**6. Catalog Expansion & Creative Direction**

* Continuously expand Controlled Insanity's apparel catalog with new garment bases and product categories.
* Build a library of original, reusable garment silhouettes and construction concepts.
* Work alongside the creative and marketing teams to ensure products align with upcoming collections and brand direction.
* Help establish consistent design standards across all product categories.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Has professional experience in apparel design, technical design, or product development.
* Has extensive knowledge of garment construction, pattern development, and apparel manufacturing.
* Is highly proficient in creating professional tech packs.
* Has experience working with overseas and domestic manufacturers.
* Understands fabric compositions, GSM, garment washes, stitching, and construction techniques.
* Has a strong understanding of bodybuilding apparel, streetwear, and contemporary fashion.
* Is extremely creative and constantly generating new product ideas.
* Can work independently, identify opportunities, and take concepts from initial sketches to finished products.
* Has a strong portfolio demonstrating original garment development, technical drawings, and completed products.

Performance Expectations

* Consistently present new garment concepts and product innovations.
* Maintain a pipeline of new products and garment bases under development.
* Deliver accurate, detailed tech packs for approved designs.
* Maintain communication with manufacturers and monitor sampling progress.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve existing products and expand the catalog.
* Bring proactive ideas and creative solutions to the brand on an ongoing basis.

title: Head of YouTube (Strategy, Scripting & Team Lead)
description:
**IMPORTANT PLEASE READ THE FULL APPLICATION CAREFULLY. IF YOU MISS ANY OF THE ANSWER FIELDS YOU WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.**  
  
We're hiring a **Head of YouTube** to lead Richard Yu's channels and creative team. Richard teaches people how to build businesses selling digital and physical products through "AI Arbitrage"

### **✅ The challenge**

Our immediate goal is to grow the business channel from ~90,000 to 200,000+ subscribers in six months and bring average views per video above 100,000. These are aggressive goals. We want someone excited by that challenge, with a clear approach to choosing what to make, testing ideas and getting good videos out consistently.

You'll grow the top of the funnel by reaching new viewers who fit our audience. You'll also plan content for viewers who are getting to know Richard, learning about our offers and deciding whether to buy. Ultimately, we want this channel to grow the business, so views and subscribers need to translate into an audience we can serve.

You'll be responsible for what we make, why we make it, how we package and produce it, and whether it worked. You'll work directly with Richard and the leadership team to set direction, goals and KPI's and lead, hire and manage a creative team underneath.

**This is a senior creative strategist and operator role**.
  
  
You will write first-person, long-form scripts yourself, as well as review and improve other writers' work. You should be equally comfortable setting channel direction, giving specific feedback and getting videos published.

### **✅ What you'll own**

* **Strategy and ideation:** own the channel's growth goals, metrics and KPIs. Turn them into a clear plan for topics, formats and ideas, based on what our audience cares about and what we can learn from videos that perform well above their channel's usual results. Plan videos that bring in new viewers, build trust and help the right people take the next step.
* **Testing and learning:** build structured tests with a clear hypothesis, a useful comparison and defined success measures. Decide which tests are worth running, make sense of the results and apply what you learn to the next videos.
* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **✅ Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **✅ Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **✅ How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context.
  
  
**IMPORTANT TO BE CONSIDERED YOU MUST SHARE A 3–5 MINUTE VIDEO COVERING:**

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + **You’ve grown a YouTube channel and can show the results and your contribution.** We strongly prefer experience in business, making money online, finance or startups. We’ll also consider strong results in tech, personal growth, edutainment or entertainment.
              + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.
  + **A team invested in your growth.** We want this to be one of the biggest personal and professional growth experiences of your life. You’ll work directly with Richard and the rest of the leadership team, get honest feedback and take on challenges that stretch your thinking, creative judgment and leadership. We set high standards, and we’re here to help you reach them.
  + **$75,000–$150,000 USD annually plus performance bonuses for exceptional results, in a fully remote, full-time role with reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.**
